### **Company Description**

Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. We’re a global community of bold visionaries and resourceful doers shaping the future of Dropbox and, in turn, the future of work. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you’re ready to push boundaries and challenge yourself, Dropbox is ready for you.

### **Team Description**

The Dropbox Marketing Team shows the world how Dropbox makes work better. We're storytellers and strategists, exploring new ways to connect our products with the people who need them. From product launches to campaign strategy, message positioning to digital marketing, we blend creativity with data-driven insights to build our brand and grow our impact. Working across disciplines, you will tap into your own inventiveness while collaborating with teams throughout the organization, including Product, Sales and Engineering. If you're excited about translating complex technologies into engaging narratives and shaping how the world understands and experiences Dropbox, join our Marketing team.

### **Virtual First**

Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. While remote work is the primary experience for our employees, we also prioritize intentional, in-person connection. We bring teams together through regular team gatherings, on-demand workspaces, and Dropbox Neighborhood events in order to strengthen team cohesion, foster creativity, and enhance momentum. Virtual First is built to provide the same access to opportunity, growth, and impact for everyone, regardless of location.

This role requires travel to offsites and various other team gatherings (approximately 5-10% of the year or 2-3 days per quarter). We provide advance notice when possible and encourage candidates to discuss any accommodation needs during the interview process.

### **AI Fluency**

AI fluency is a core part of how we work and grow. It’s not about being an expert—it’s about using these tools thoughtfully and effectively to improve your work and support others.

We look for four key behaviors in candidates:

* **Ownership**: You use AI responsibly by protecting data, applying sound judgment, and taking accountability for the quality and accuracy of your work.
* **Experimentation:** You explore new AI capabilities and apply them to improve workflows within approved tools and practices.
* **Leverage:** You use AI to enhance thinking, improve efficiency, and increase your impact and your team’s.
* **Learning:** You stay current on emerging AI tools and trends, continuously build your skills, and share what you learn with others.

Together, these behaviors help build a workforce where technology amplifies human judgment, creativity, and impact.

jobs.title: Senior Copywriter (Direct Response)
jobs.desc:
We're looking for a direct response copywriter who can own messaging strategy across a client pod in our info/coaching marketing agency.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional pod alongside a strategist, media buyer, and PM - writing ad scripts, funnel copy, emails, webinars, and sales pages for clients spending $100k-$1M+ monthly on ads. You'll also be participating in creative strategy alongside your team - analyzing what's working, deciding what to iterate on, and bringing ideas backed by reasoning, not just executing what you're handed.

This is not an order-taker role. You won't be waiting for someone to hand you a brief and tell you exactly what to write. You'll be reviewing performance data, understanding why winners win, and coming to creative strategy calls with "here's what we should test and why" - not just "ready for my next assignment."

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* You come to creative strategy calls with prepared ideas and hypotheses - not just ready to receive direction
* You can explain *why* a winning ad works (awareness level, belief shift, lead type) - not just *that* it works
* Your first drafts are close to final - strategists aren't rewriting your copy, they're refining it
* You know what's winning and losing across your clients without being asked
* Iterations are based on insight (what belief shift is landing, what objection we're not handling) - not surface-level changes (let's try a different hook)
* The strategist trusts you to lead on messaging and creative concepts so they can focus on client relationships and offer strategy
* Your avatar docs and messaging foundations are useful references the whole team pulls from - not boxes you filled in to complete a task

**A Day In This Role**
----------------------

**Morning:** Check the creative tracker for your clients. What launched? What's testing? Any winners or losers from the last batch? Review any feedback or revision requests that came in overnight.

**Writing blocks:** The bulk of your day is writing - ad scripts, body copy, emails, funnel pages, or long-form projects like webinars or VSLs. You're working from briefs you helped shape, not briefs handed to you fully formed.

**Creative strategy calls:** Weekly with your pod. You come prepared with analysis: what's working, what's not, what we should iterate on, what net-new concepts are worth testing. You leave with a plan for what's needed and why.

**Throughout the day:**

* Fill out creative briefs with the strategic reasoning (idea, angle, awareness level, lead type, variation) - not just the copy itself
* Update the creative tracker with your batch details before submitting for review
* Collaborate with your strategist on messaging direction, offer positioning, and funnel improvements
* Coordinate with creative leads on video scripts and static direction

**End of day:** You can answer: What's the status of my active batches? What's winning/losing for each client? What's next and why?

**Experience & Requirements**
-----------------------------

* 3+ years of direct response copywriting experience; info/coaching space strongly preferred
* Deep understanding of awareness levels, belief shifts, and long-form persuasion structures (not just short-form social copy)
* Experience writing across formats: ad scripts, body copy, emails, sales pages, webinars/VSLs
* Ability to analyze creative performance and iterate intelligently - not just "try something different"
* Strong grasp of avatar psychology and offer positioning - you understand *why* messaging works, not just *what* to write
* Comfortable working within structured systems (creative trackers, naming conventions, brief templates)
* Can take loose direction ("we need to test a new angle for this audience segment") and return with developed concepts backed by reasoning

**What This Role Is Not**
-------------------------

**Not word-outputting.** Writing without understanding the strategy behind it - the offer

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Brand Marketing
jobs.desc:
ColourPop is all about accessible, trend-driven beauty that moves at the speed of culture. Known for rapid launches, viral moments, and a passionate community, we create high-quality, cruelty-free products that bring what’s next in beauty to our fans first. As part of the Seed Beauty family, we redefine what it means to innovate fast — and have fun doing it.  
  
\*\*This is an onsite role in our Sherman Oaks, CA office  
  
**01** **POSITION SUMMARY**  
  
This role is for the rare person who lives at the intersection of brand, growth, and creative. Part cultural tastemaker, part growth strategist. You spot trends before they have names. You build narratives that make people feel something — and then you back them up with the numbers that prove it worked. You're equally at home in a creative brief and a channel performance review, and you know that the best marketing is a hybrid of both.  
  
ColourPop is a bold, boundary-pushing beauty brand with one of the most devoted communities in the industry — and we've built that by being audacious enough to move first, and conviction-led enough to see it through. The Sr. Brand Marketing Manager is the person who keeps that edge sharp: translating brand obsession into go-to-market strategy, shaping stories that ignite our community across social, influencer, PR, paid, and retail, and driving accountability across every channel we touch. You're building something category-defying from the inside out. We need someone obsessed with beauty and the community around it, and hungry to push this brand further than it's ever been. If you're the kind of person who sees a whitespace before anyone else does and can't wait to fill it, this is your role.  
**02** **RESPONSIBILITIES**  

* **Go-to-Market Leadership.** Lead and support end-to-end GTM strategy for key franchise and innovation launches — from positioning and campaign platform through retailer execution and post-launch performance reporting.
* **Brand Storytelling.** Craft the narratives that stop the scroll and start buying. Build breakthrough campaigns with a clear POV and a through-line that holds from concept to shelf — across every format, channel, and audience.
* **Campaign Architecture.** Translate product truth into breakthrough creative. Push the work until it's genuinely unforgettable — not just on-brand. You're the person who makes the brief great, not just the one who approves it.
* **Cross-Channel GTM Support.** Partner with Social, Influencer, PR, Paid Media, and DTC teams to ensure every launch lands with consistency and impact across every touchpoint. Inconsistency is where brand love dies — you make sure it doesn't.
* **Budget Management & Performance.** Own and manage marketing budgets across campaigns and channels. Track performance metrics — reach, engagement, conversion, ROAS — and optimize spend to maximize ROI at every stage of the funnel.
* **Revenue Accountability.** Lead with numbers, not lean on them. Come to every business review with a clear story — what the data says, what it means, and what we do next.
* **Insights Action.** Pull from consumer data, cultural signals, and competitor intel to surface growth opportunities. Don't just report what happened — explain why, and say what we do about it.
* **Retail & Partner Programs.** Build compelling sell-in narratives and retail activation plans for Ulta, Target, and emerging channels. Make the buyer as obsessed as our community.
* **Infrastructure & Playbooks.** Build the launch frameworks that scale. If a process doesn't exist and it should, create it — no waiting, no hiding behind 'that's not my job.'
* **Multi-Hat Mentality.** You don't clock out at the edge of your role. When something needs to get done, you do it — and you're energized by the range, not depleted by it.
* **Senior Stakeholder Presence.** Run briefings that align cross-functional teams fast. Influence without authority. Move people, not just decks.

**03** **REQUIREMENTS**  

* **5+ years**

This is a rare chance to shape a DTC motion from day one and help build Till into a best-in-class consumer brand for families.

You will own how Till acquires new families directly, from the moment a parent first discovers Till to the moment they subscribe, backed by a significant paid media budget. You will run paid social, search and affiliate through our agency partner, build a creative testing engine, and own conversion on tillfinancial.com. You are accountable for CAC, payback and conversion to paid against our subscriber target.  
  
This is a senior, hands-on role reporting to the Head of GTM. You will work closely with:

* **Lifecycle Marketer:** brings back families who stall before subscribing and owns everything after a family subscribes. You own conversion to paid, in partnership with Lifecycle and Product. Their retention-by-channel data helps you put budget where families stay.
* **Agency partner:** manages paid spend and develops creative from your briefs. You own the day-to-day relationship: you set the strategy, hold them accountable for performance and own budget allocation.
* **Brand and Design:** your partners on creative, landing pages and the Till website. You bring creative and strategic ideas, such as new ad concepts, hooks, offers and landing page experiences, and test and optimize them, and they help bring those ideas to life within our brand.

* **Build a creative testing engine.** Run an always-on testing roadmap for concepts, hooks, formats and UGC with our agency partner, who produces the creative. Write clear briefs, turn results into insights for Brand, Lifecycle and Product, and manage the compliance review workflow for ads.
* **Own conversion on tillfinancial.com.** Lead landing page and funnel testing, from first visit through subscription, including a paywall testing agenda agreed with Product, with support from Brand and Design on messaging and design for new tests. You bring the ideas and the testing plan; you don't need to be a designer or copywriter.
* **Know our families deeply.** Understand what motivates parents of young kids and parents of teens, and use research and performance data to build and test campaigns and landing pages that speak to each.
* **Expand channels and build the brand.** Identify, test and scale new acquisition channels with structured experiments, and turn what works into repeatable playbooks. * **Own the growth tech stack.** Set up and manage ad account structure, conversion tracking (pixels, Meta's Conversions API, a mobile measurement partner and SKAN), tag management, UTM and campaign taxonomy, and affiliate and testing tools, working with Data on reporting.

* 5-7+ years in growth or performance marketing for a consumer mobile

Talkdesk competes in a fast-moving enterprise market where durable, efficient growth separates market leaders from companies that simply outspend their way to results. To win, Talkdesk needs a disciplined go-to-market engine: one where every investment translates directly into results, resources are deployed with precision, and strategy converts to flawless execution.

This role of Senior Manager of Marketing Operations is central to delivering on this need. Sitting at the bridge between high-level GTM strategy and day-to-day execution, you will ensure marketing investments directly drive pipeline and business growth. You will give leadership the strategic clarity needed to deploy resources for maximum return, while establishing the framework that clearly demonstrates marketing's full value.

You are at the center of the Marketing organization, partnering directly with the CMO, marketing leadership, campaign leads and project managers. While your peers manage the underlying martech systems, automation workflows and campaign requests, you will own the operational rhythms that power the department: fiscal planning, cross-functional program governance and actionable executive insights.

In practice, that means championing insights over information. You will look past reports and dashboards to uncover the root causes behind the numbers, analyzing full-funnel performance to guide what programs to scale, what to reduce and where the next dollar of investment should go. jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing
jobs.desc:
**Who We Are:**

SmithRx is a rapidly growing, venture-backed Health-Tech company. Our mission is to disrupt the expensive and inefficient Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) sector by building a next-generation drug acquisition platform driven by cutting edge technology, innovative cost saving tools, and best-in-class customer service. With hundreds of thousands of members onboarded since 2016, SmithRx has a solution that is resonating with clients all across the country.

We pride ourselves for our mission-driven and collaborative culture that inspires our employees to do their best work. We believe that the U.S healthcare system is in need of transformation, and we come to work each day dedicated to making that change a reality. At our core, we are guided by our company values:

* **Integrity:** Our purpose guides our actions and gives us confidence in the path ahead. With unwavering honesty and dependability, we embrace the pressure of challenging the old and exemplify ethical leadership to create the new.
* **Courage:** We face continuous challenges with grit and resilience. We embrace the discomfort of the unknown by balancing autonomy with empathy, and ownership with vulnerability. We boldly challenge the status quo to keep moving forward—always.
* **Together:** The success of SmithRx reflects the strength of our partnerships and the commitment of our team. Our shared values bind us together and make us one. When one falls, we all fall; when one rises, we all rise.

**Job Summary:**

  

We are looking for a strategic and visionary Leader of Product Marketing who will be responsible for leading our overall go-to-market strategy, product positioning, and sales enablement efforts. SmithRx isn't just building another technology platform; we are rebuilding the pharmacy benefits category from the ground up. In this highly cross-functional leadership role, you will define how we communicate the radical value of SmithRx's platform to brokers, employers, consultants, and members, establishing us as the clear alternative to the broken status quo.

You will be responsible for building, mentoring, and scaling a high-performing product marketing team, bringing complex new capabilities to market, and driving greater adoption of our products and services. As we expand our platform capabilities, a critical part of this role will be navigating the narrative around Artificial Intelligence in healthcare. You will lead the charge in educating our market, building trust around our AI-powered features, and demonstrating how these technologies improve outcomes.

To be successful in this role, you should demonstrate a strong track record of scaling PMM functions, driving category creation, translating complex and emerging technologies into compelling stories, and partnering closely with executive leadership across Product and Sales. You must be comfortable operating in an unstructured, fast-paced environment and learning as you experiment.

**What you will do:**

* **Guide Category Creation:** Positions SmithRx as a radical departure from traditional PBMs. You will shape market perception and educate the industry on a fundamentally new way to approach pharmacy benefits.
* **Own GTM Strategy:** Drive the overarching Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy for SmithRx's platform and new product features, coordinating cross-functional launches across Product, Clinical Programs, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to ensure successful rollouts.
* **AI Narrative & Trust Building:** Develop and execute GTM strategies for our AI-powered products and features, crafting transparent, education-driven messaging that overcomes industry skepticism and builds deep trust with employers, brokers, and members.
* **Team Leadership:** Hire, lead, and develop a team of high-performing product marketers.
* **Positioning & Messaging:** Work with our content team to establish compelling, differentiated positioning and messaging that clearly articulates SmithRx's unique value

jobs.title: Vice President, Performance Marketing
jobs.desc:
CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omnichannel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis, our operating platform combining a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins. With $1B+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and others that serve as real-world innovation labs.

**Location:** Remote (USA or Canada)

### **About the Role:**

CSC Generation is looking for a Vice President of Performance Marketing to own paid media strategy and the paid media P&L across our portfolio of 13 brands, including Sur La Table, Backcountry, and One Kings Lane. As **Vice President, Performance Marketing**, you will set multi-year direction, build the team and agency bench to execute against it, and represent performance marketing on CSC Generation's leadership team.

In your first year, success means establishing a unified performance marketing strategy across the portfolio, standing up the right team structure, and demonstrating measurable improvement in blended CAC and media efficiency. You will partner closely with Creative, Merchandising, and eCommerce leadership to ensure paid investment, assortment, and creative strategy reinforce each other.

This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

### **What You'll Do:**

#### **Performance Marketing Strategy**

* Own the performance marketing P&L and multi-year strategy across the brand portfolio, spanning paid search, paid social, shopping/feed, display, affiliate, video/TV, and emerging channels.
* Set channel and budget allocation based on incrementality, LTV, and blended CAC targets, and defend those trade-offs to the executive team.
* Translate company revenue and margin targets into a multi-year paid media investment plan.
* Build repeatable playbooks for launches, promotions, and seasonal peaks that scale across brands.
* Track competitor activity and market trends to spot new channels, formats, and positioning opportunities.

#### **Team Leadership & Organization**

* Build and lead a team of performance marketing leaders and specialists, plus supporting agencies.
* Set operating standards for testing velocity, reporting rigor, and channel expertise, and hold your leadership team accountable to them.
* Stay close enough to the numbers to catch problems early, coach through them, and step in directly when needed.
* Hold agency partners accountable to performance benchmarks, media efficiency, and clear scopes of work.
* Own new channel expansion, including hands-on execution of initial campaigns in new channels.
* Champion a continuous A/B and multivariate testing culture across creative, landing pages, and audience targeting, turning results into scaled learnings.
* Drive adoption and demonstrated use of AI and automation tools across the team to improve decisions, increase output, and free up time for high-value work.

#### **Executive & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Sit on CSC Generation's marketing leadership team and represent performance marketing in company-level strategy and planning.
* Partner with Creative to ensure ad concepts and assets are built for performance from the start.
* Partner with Merchandising to align paid spend with inventory, margin, and assortment priorities.
* Partner with eCommerce, Product, and Web Development to ensure landing pages, site experience, and conversion funnels support paid traffic quality.
* Translate performance data into clear commercial recommendations for the executive team—not just channel-level metrics.
* Flag risks and opportunities early and bring solutions rather than just problems.

### **Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
* 12+ years of experience in performance marketing or paid media,

**About OpenArt**
=================

OpenArt is a gen AI creative platform used by millions worldwide. We’re building the next generation of creative tools powered by cutting-edge AI, enabling anyone to create videos, images, visuals, characters, and stories with unprecedented speed and imagination.

We believe the future of creativity is AI-native, and we’re shaping that future.

**Why Join OpenArt**

**About the Role**
==================

OpenArt is looking for a **Head of Influencer Marketing** to build and lead influencer marketing as a major growth channel for the company.

* Excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship-build

**Multi-Brand Director of Operations Overview**

Are you an experienced restaurant operator who knows how to make the most of a challenging operation?

We are seeking a **Multi-Brand Director of Operations** to lead restaurant teams across multiple locations and two QSR brands. This role is ideal for an experienced Director of Operations seeking a lateral move, a high-performing Area or District Manager ready to expand their scope, or an exceptional multi-unit leader looking for a larger challenge.

Our restaurants operate in a very different environment than many high-volume, highly staffed restaurant concepts. We operate **lower-volume locations where labor efficiency, equipment reliability, food cost, speed of service, and guest experience all matter every day.** Many locations operate with lean staffing, including periods of single coverage, and our customer base is highly value-conscious.

The ideal candidate understands how to lead in this environment, not simply by following a playbook, but by recognizing problems early, making good decisions with limited resources, and developing managers who can do the same.

You should be comfortable operating restaurants where:

Much of the menu is prepared live in front of the customer  
Sandwiches, beverages, and other products require consistent execution at the point of sale  
Labor must be carefully managed because restaurants may operate with lean or single-person coverage  
Sales and customer traffic can vary significantly by season, weather, school schedules, and local events  
Average check sizes are relatively low and customers are highly value-driven  
Equipment may be older and approaching the end of its useful life  
Operators need to know when equipment can be maintained, when it needs to be repaired, and when replacement is the better economic decision  
Small operational improvements can have a meaningful impact on profitability

If you enjoy **developing leaders, improving imperfect operations, solving problems with limited resources, and turning average restaurants into consistently well-run restaurants**, we'd like to hear from you.

At Neighbor, we're building the largest hyperlocal storage and parking marketplace in the world. We've raised over $75 million from top-tier investors including Andreessen Horowitz and the CEOs of DoorDash, StockX, and Uber. Our marketplace operates in all 50 states, and we're just getting started.

### **About the Role**

Neighbor is hiring a Head of Performance Marketing to own paid acquisition across our marketplace and scale revenue at efficient returns. This is a hands-on, player-coach role. You'll work directly with our VP of Marketing and lead a team of three paid performance leads (one each for item storage, vehicle, and supply) to execute, scale, and systematize paid growth.

You'll thrive here if you're a scrappy executor who's as comfortable running Meta campaigns as building forecasts, partnering with the Data team on attribution, and coaching your team. You'll own paid like your own P&L: setting budgets by channel and vertical, owning ROAS and revenue targets, and deciding where the next dollar goes as our budget continues to scale.

Because Neighbor is a two-sided marketplace with dozens of use cases, paid here is a constant flow of persona and theme tests rather than one evergreen campaign. On any given week, the team might be testing classic car storage creative on Meta, capturing high-intent parking searches in New York City on Google, and running home-organizer creator ads for self storage, all while preparing for seasonal peaks like RV and trailer storage. You'll also lead our push up-funnel into CTV and other offline channels, working with media partners and our Data team to measure what's incremental.

* Partner with Data on conversion tracking and dashboards so every paid channel is measured with confidence
* Partner with Lifecycle and Sales to turn host leads generated by paid into closed supply

====================

The Director, Performance Media leads BMG360’s pay-per-performance media business and owns its P&L. This is a commercial leadership role as much as a media role: the group buys media at risk, is paid on delivered performance, and makes or loses money on the accuracy of its forecasting and the discipline of its buying. Reporting to the SVP, Performance, this leader runs the Performance Media team which includes two Managers and several Senior Analysts/ Analysts across traditional lead generation channels with digital being secondary. They are accountable for profitable volume: hitting client call and lead thresholds while protecting the margin on every buy, and for scaling the group through cross-sell, new bundle activation, and the right new business. jobs.title: Head of Growth/Organic - Letaido
jobs.desc:
Letaido is an AI teammate for marketing teams. Not a chatbot: an agent with its own workspace that does the work. It pulls the data, builds the tool, ships the page, and keeps it running. It's built inside Ahrefs, so it runs on fifteen years of crawl data and the index behind one of the most-used SEO tools in the world.

We need the person who makes people find it.

### **The job**

Search is splitting in two. People still Google, and more and more they ask ChatGPT, Perplexity or Gemini which tool to use. You'll own both, from zero, for a product whose users are marketers who can smell a weak claim.

You'll be the first person accountable for Letaido's organic growth. No playbook, no agency, no inherited channel. Just a new domain, the best SEO dataset there is, and a product that can build half your tooling for you.

### **What you'll actually do**

* **Grow letaido from a standing start.** Site architecture, indexation, internal linking, the content plan, and the first hundred pieces. Early on, you write most of them.
* **Get Letaido cited by AI assistants.** Work out what moves citations and what's just fashionable to claim. You'll measure it with Ahrefs Brand Radar, which almost nobody else in this job has.
* **Publish what the product builds.** The best marketing for an agent that builds things is the things it built.
* **Run experiments past search** where they earn it: programmatic pages, free tools, newsletter, partnerships, community, paid.
* **Instrument everything** and say plainly what isn't working.
* **Hire the team** once you've proved the channel.

### **You're probably right for this if**

* **You've grown a site's organic traffic yourself, and can name the domain.** A side project, an early startup, an affiliate site you built at night: all count. We'd rather see the graph than a job title.
* **You do the work.** You write, you fix the template, you argue with the engineer about the canonical tags.
* **Your technical SEO goes beyond tool names.** You can explain the decision, not just the audit.
* **You think in experiments.** You've shipped growth bets beyond content and killed the ones that didn't work.
* **You have a view on AI search** that you could defend with evidence, not a newsletter post.
* **You'd rather own a number than manage a process.**

You don't need a following, a conference talk or a course. Some of the best SEOs we know have none of those. If your work has spoken for itself so far, that's the profile we want.

### **Good to have**

* Marketed to practitioners: developers, marketers, SEOs.
* Built with LLMs or agents enough to know where they're genuinely useful.
* Product-led growth: free tools, programmatic SEO, localisation, activation.
* Hired writers or editors.

### **How we hire**

We'll look up the domains you tell us about in Ahrefs. It's the honest way to hire for this role, and it means a quiet track record counts as much as a loud one. Ranges are fine; just be accurate.

### **Where and how**

On-site in Palo Alto (CA) or Cambridge (MA). US right to work required. Reporting directly to the Head of Letaido: one conversation between an idea and a decision.

### **What we offer**

* A channel that's yours to build and run your way
* The data and tooling of a fifteen-year-old SEO company behind an early-stage product
* Daily use of what you're marketing, and a direct line to the people building it
* Bootstrapped and profitable for fifteen years: no investor timeline
* Annual company retreat (usually skiing), learning and conference budget, a proper office, and lunch on us

Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third party recruitment solutions for the roles we hire for. If at any point we need help, we'll let you know!

jobs.title: Head of Growth
jobs.desc:
About Us

UGLYCASH is the financial home for people who make money on the internet.

The way people work and make money has fundamentally changed. People build businesses online, freelance across borders, create content, sell products, and work remotely. Their banks were never designed around how they earn.

We believe opportunity should evolve with the people creating it.

We’re building financial services for this new generation of earners, especially those earning online and across borders, lack access to credit and the financial tools they need to grow.

We want to replace fine print with candid transparency, discrimination with global financial inclusion, and cold, distant institutions with a human connection to the people we serve.

Our mission goes deeper. We believe access to stable currency and financial opportunity is a human right. The internet has opened up entirely new ways for people around the world to earn. Now the financial system needs to catch up.

The Role

We’re looking for a Head of Growth to own UGLYCASH’s marketing and acquisition go-to-market, from the first time someone hears about us to the moment they become an active customer.

One person with the range to operate an entire growth team, using agents, automation, code, creativity, and good judgment.

You can find a customer insight, turn it into an offer, build the landing page, create the campaign, launch the ads, set up the email journey, instrument the funnel, and figure out what worked. Then build the systems that let you do it again, faster and at greater scale.

You don’t just use AI to produce marketing. You build agent-powered systems that help run it.

This is a senior, hands-on role with leadership-level ownership. You will own both the strategy and the execution. The plan is not to hire a department around you. It is to build an acquisition engine whose capacity grows through better systems and agents.

You’ll work directly with the founder and collaborate with product, engineering, and creative contributors. You won’t do every task alone, but you will own the outcome.

What You’ll Own

**Acquisition strategy and execution.**  
Decide which customers to pursue, what offers and messages will resonate, and which channels deserve our attention and budget. Own the whole funnel: discovery, landing pages, signup, first funding, first income payment, and repeat use. Being capable across channels does not mean running all of them at once. Your job is to find what works and focus.

**Product marketing and launches.**  
Understand how our customers earn and turn that understanding into positioning, messaging, landing pages, offers, and campaigns. Translate product capabilities into clear reasons to choose UGLYCASH. Own the marketing side of launches, from the initial customer insight through distribution and adoption.

**Paid acquisition and conversion.**  
Build, launch, and optimize paid campaigns yourself. Develop creative angles, test audiences and offers, improve landing pages, manage budgets, and connect spend to customer outcomes. Run disciplined tests before scaling. Know when to increase investment and when to stop.

**Clipping, UGC, creators, and influencer strategy.**  
Build a repeatable process for finding and improving winning content rather than depending on the next viral hit.

**Email marketing and lifecycle.**  
Build segmented, behavior-based email journeys that turn interest into signups and signups into active customers. Own onboarding, activation, product education, referrals, and reactivation campaigns. Make the message relevant to what the customer needs and what they have actually done.

**The agent-powered growth system.**  
Build and maintain workflows for customer research, creative variations, creator discovery, outreach preparation, campaign operations, reporting, and experiment analysis. jobs.title: HEAD OF CONTENT / DIGITAL MARKETING
jobs.desc:
**HEAD OF CONTENT / DIGITAL MARKETING** (Fractional, 1099 Contract, DMV Local Only)  
*Blue Goose Solutions | Oxon Hill, MD*

Blue Goose Solutions is a marketing, communications, and events firm for nonprofits and mission driven organizations. We help them get found by people who already care about their work, then turn that attention into trust and funding. Our founder runs content strategy himself today, and we are looking for a proven content person to take it over.

We are open to a freelancer, a fractional lead, or the owner of a small shop. What matters to us is that one named person does the work, **lives in the DMV (DC, Maryland, or Northern Virginia)**, and has a track record of getting views.

**What you'll own**  
- You set content strategy for our clients and run the monthly strategy session with each one.  
- You grow views and followers on client accounts and on Blue Goose's own channels, and you report the numbers to the founder each month.  
- You approve scripts, posts, and content plans before anything goes to a client or a videographer.  
- You lead Blue Goose's own marketing, including our LinkedIn, our newsletter, and the founder's personal brand content.  
- You hire and direct our Marketing Operations Coordinator, with the founder signing off on your pick. They handle scheduling, files, and client follow up.  
- You join us in person in the DC area for monthly content shoot days, client sessions, and events.

**What we're looking for**  
- You have grown accounts before and can show us the numbers before and after.  
- You know short form video well enough to explain why one video gets watched and another gets skipped.  
- You can lead a client call on your own and explain your thinking in plain language.  
- You already run your work like a business, with your own tools, your own schedule, and other clients if you want them.  
- You live in the DMV, since this role is local only and includes in person days a few times a month. Experience with nonprofits, advocacy groups, or associations also helps.  
- It is a real plus if you can shoot and edit video yourself, though we do not require it.

**How the engagement works**  
- We start with a 3 month trial, with view and follower targets we agree on in the first week.  
- We check progress together at 30, 60, and 90 days, and a strong trial becomes an ongoing monthly retainer.  
- We plan content in monthly batches, film on a monthly shoot day, and keep posts scheduled one to two weeks ahead. AI tools handle much of our first drafting and research, so your time goes to direction and quality.

**Pay**  
- This is a 1099 contract that pays a flat $3,500 to $4,500 a month, based on your track record.  
- Most people would size this scope at about 20 hours a week, and you set your own schedule outside of client calls and shoot days.  
- Local travel to in person days is part of the scope and is not reimbursed.

**To apply, send a short note on why this fits you, links to two or three accounts or videos you grew with the numbers, and your availability to info@bluegoose.co.**

Pay: $3,500.00 - $4,500.00 per month

jobs.title: Head of Product Marketing
jobs.desc:
**The role**
------------

We're in the midst of the most important buildout in U.S. history, with large growth across energy, transmission, commercial/industrial, housing, and conservation + carbon. Land is the bottleneck for all of these efforts. Aarden is a purpose-built solution to understand, invest in, and get deals done for land-dependent assets.

While only 16 months old, we are already working with the most important landowners and developers in the country, and it's time for the world to know about us. That's where you come in.

As Head of Product Marketing, your job is to show the market how Aarden thinks about land, in public, every week, and use that as a launching point to make Aarden the most influential and important voice in land markets. When a hyperscaler announces a campus, a county passes a moratorium, or a timber owner sells a million acres, you'll use Aarden to figure out what it means within the broader market context, what owners and developers should be doing in response, and what new opportunities it creates. Aarden is used to help clients make decisions like this every day, and your job is to elevate these capabilities to a much broader audience.

Over time, we want Aarden (and its leadership) to be who people turn to when they want to understand how America's land is changing, and we want that attention to turn into conversations with the landowners, developers, and investors who make the world move.

**About Aarden**
----------------

Aarden is the origination and investment partner for people building on and making decisions about American land, starting with the landowners and developers behind the energy & data center buildouts. For institutional timber and farmland owners, that means helping them see what their land could become and how to value it. For developers, it means finding willing owners with viable sites before sinking months of time and capital into a site that faces significant headwinds. For everyone, it means understanding the environmental and social impacts of these important decisions.

Under the hood, our platform combines parcel data, ownership resolution, zoning, community sentiment, and price signals with suitability models and defensible investment analysis.

We're a Seattle-based team, growing quickly and founded in 2025, with expansion plans into NYC in 2027. Four of the ten largest U.S. landowners are already clients, and our committed clients cover roughly 14 million acres of high value land. We have a wonderful cohort of investors as well. Our $4m pre-seed was announced last year but our subsequent fundraising efforts remain undisclosed; you would help us announce this.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Hunt for stories.** Read the news every day across data centers, energy, timber, farmland, and land policy, and comment on key events that change land markets (there are a lot of these!).
* **Use Aarden to find the answer.** Work with Aarden technology to figure out what each event means, lay out the options it creates for owners and developers, and back it up with historical and present-day patterns. Our data team will support you in this work.
* **Build Aarden's following on LinkedIn and X.** Publish several times a week across the company's and leadership's channels, and grow those audiences. You'll develop your own voice along the way, too.
* **Tell client stories.** Highlight our clients' efforts and help them grow their businesses with case studies that show how the smartest investors in the country partner with Aarden to drive results for their funds.
* **Turn attention into pipeline.** The stories we tell should help more organizations see the clear benefits of partnering with Aarden.
* **Speak to both sides of the market.** Write for timber and farmland owners who are weighing alternative uses, and for data center developers who are quite literally racing to secure sites. Help each learn about the benefits of working with the other.
* **Make Aarden

jobs.desc:
nicity is a health intervention company. We connect people with the products, the app, and the community that together can genuinely change their health — starting with our yerba maté formulated to support fasting and a fibre drink that slows carb absorption at mealtime, brought together in the Feel Great program. Our customers don't just buy a supplement; they start a program that reshapes how they eat, how they feel, and how they live. That means the experience we build — from the first page someone lands on, through checkout, into the app, and across every week after — is what determines whether a customer actually transforms their health or drifts away.  
  
About the Role  
We're hiring a Director of Growth to own the entire e-commerce funnel, acquisition *and* retention - from a customer's first visit through checkout, first-purchase activation, and long-term repeat revenue. You'll lead two initiatives (Web/CRO and Email/Lifecycle) and be accountable for how they work as one system rather than two silos handing customers back and forth.  
  
This is a builder-operator role, not a strategy-deck role. We want someone with hundreds of reps running structured experiments, who reads a funnel like a P&L, and who has personally shipped the tests, not just approved someone else's roadmap. You'll set the growth strategy and then implement it.  
  
We are in the middle of redefining our tech stack, and you’ll collaborate directly with the Director of Product and Tech Leads to make sure your team has the tools it needs to succeed.  
  
What You'll Own

* The full funnel, as one number. Conversion, AOV, activation, repeat rate, and customer LTV — one connected model, not a web metric and an email metric that never meet. You'll know exactly where visitors drop off across the entire lifecycle and why.
* A high-velocity testing program. Build and run the experimentation engine across landing pages, product pages, checkout, onboarding, and lifecycle email/SMS. Prioritize by expected impact, ship weekly, and hold the team to a real read on what won and what didn't. Our traffic comes with high built-in intent rather than from paid ads — so tests have to be designed for the volume and audience we actually have.
* First-purchase acquisition. Maximize the yield of every visit: page experience, offer structure, and first-purchase conversion. Our customers arrive with intent already established, so the job is to convert that intent — not manufacture it.
* Retention and lifecycle. Oversee our email/SMS team, onboarding, activation into the Feel Great app, re-order, winback, and reactivation. Grow repeat revenue and LTV as deliberately as first-purchase conversion.
* The promo and launch calendar. Ship the site pages, offers, and lifecycle flows behind product launches and promotions, coordinating timelines across marketing and design.
* Instrumentation and truth. Own tracking and reporting so the whole company sees the same funnel weekly, and turn it into a visible, prioritized hypothesis backlog. Bring the qualitative "why" — reviews, support tickets, surveys, session replays — because we can't lean on paid-channel data for audience insight.
* The team. Manage, coach, and raise the bar for the employees on the team (currently 4 people across Web/CRO and Email/Lifecycle); hire to fill gaps; set the operating cadence (weekly test reviews, roadmap, reporting).

  

What We're Looking For

National Painting Group · Fort Collins, CO · Full-Time (Hybrid)

**I'm Eric, co-founder of National Painting Group, and we hire TOP performers.**

We have a portfolio of 15 painting companies and 10 more in due diligence, years of past clients and leads, and nothing built yet to nurture them. What we need is the person who builds that engine and owns it. We're hoping that's you.

**Keep reading if…**

* You love building nurture programs. SMS, email, direct mail and phone rhythms that turn a database into referrals and repeat business are what you'd build even if no one paid you.

* You want to love where you work: the work itself, the people, and what the company stands for.

* You're coachable, and welcome feedback - and you can take feedback without taking it personal.
* You're hungry to learn, grow and develop, as a professional and as a person.

***Still with me?***

**High performance.** When you work here, you're surrounded by high performers, and we expect the same from you.

**Investment in your development.** We produce exceptional results by investing heavily in our people through ongoing internal training and development. It goes beyond training you in your role: it develops you as someone who creates and fulfills intentions, and it shows up in your entire life.

**Performance, not hours.** We believe your work should add to your life, not take from it. We don't do hustle culture or 60-hour workweeks. You should be able to conduct this role at a high level while fulfilling everything else that's important to you in your life. We'll help you do that.

**Clarity of intention & alignment.** Everyone you work with is clear on the objective, how we operate, where we're going, and the future we're committed to.

**Strategy & patience.** We have a clear plan, and we don't take shortcuts. Impeccable, thoughtful work is the source of our increasingly rapid growth.

jobs.title: Marketing Director
jobs.desc:
**About 2Modern**
-----------------

2Modern is a curated online destination for modern furniture, lighting, and decor, carrying about 300 of the best design brands. We serve design-minded consumers and a fast-growing trade program of interior designers, architects, and hospitality clients. We're a small, remote team that cares a lot about taste, craft, and doing fewer things really well.

**The role**
------------

We're looking for a Marketing Director to run our marketing engine across both sides of the business: design-minded consumers and our trade program, which is our biggest growth priority. You'll own performance across paid, email and SMS, and on-site, and make sure every dollar earns its keep. You'll also bring creative and channel thinking together, because on today's platforms the creative is the targeting.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll set strategy, lead a small team and partners, and still be close enough to the numbers and the work to know what's really happening. Your first priorities are profitable performance marketing, building a clear, well-run team, and growing trade.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own performance marketing. Set budgets and allocation across Google, Meta, affiliates, and other paid channels, with gross profit after variable costs as the measure of success.
* Build marketing for our trade program. B2B is a strategic focus. Use our channels, content, and lifecycle programs to attract and retain high-value interior designers, architects, and hospitality clients, and partner with our B2B sales team.
* Own the marketing budget and vendors. Manage the full marketing budget, plus vendor and partner contracts and renewals.
* Bring creative and performance together. Build campaigns where creative testing drives results, and work with our creative team to brief, test, and learn.
* Lead email, SMS, and lifecycle for both consumer and trade audiences, treating email as a performance channel as well as a content channel.
* Own promotions with merchandising, within agreed margin guardrails.
* Oversee organic social and reviews, including Instagram, Pinterest, and Trustpilot.
* Run affiliates end to end, from partner performance to editorial and publisher relationships.
* Build trusted measurement with finance and our data team, across channels and customer types.
* Own go-to-market and the marketing calendar. Turn quarterly brand and trend direction from our Chief Brand Officer into a clear plan for launches, campaigns, and seasonal moments, and lead it from planning through execution with merchandising, creative, and our trade team.
* Lead and shape the team. Manage and develop email and SMS, creative, copy, and agency partners, and shape the team as we grow, including whether and when to add roles.

**What success looks like in year one**
---------------------------------------

* Profitable growth across our marketing channels
* A stronger trade program, with marketing as a real driver of new trade relationships
* Trusted measurement that the whole business uses to make decisions
* A team that's clear on priorities and growing in its roles

 **Requirements**

**What you bring**
------------------

* 7+ years in e-commerce marketing, with at least 3 years leading performance marketing and managing budgets.
* Hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta, and affiliates, and a track record of growing profitably, not just growing revenue.
* Experience marketing to B2B or trade audiences (designers, architects, hospitality, or other professional buyers), or a clear point of view on how to build it.
* A strong partnership with finance. You've owned a marketing P&L or budget, worked with finance on forecasting and contribution margin, and made spend decisions based on profitability.
* Real understanding of how creative drives performance today. You can brief, structure, and read creative tests.
* A strong eye for design and brand. You can tell a great product story from an average one

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Since launching publicly in **September 2023**, Flex has scaled from **zero to nine-figure annualized revenue**, with a clear path to **profitability by late 2026**. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a **~$1T+ revenue market** hiding in plain sight. **About SkillCat**

SkillCat is building the leading education and career platform for America’s skilled trades. Hundreds of thousands of people have used SkillCat to learn HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and other trades, earn industry certifications, and build better careers without taking on massive student debt.

We’ve grown quickly, profitably, and with a small team, and we’re still early. This is an unusually high-impact marketing role: you’ll work directly with the founder, own the growth function, have the freedom to test unconventional ideas quickly, and help build a consumer brand that could define an enormous and historically underserved category.

**About the Role**

SkillCat is looking for a highly entrepreneurial Head of Growth and Marketing to find and scale the next ways we grow.

This is a hands-on role for someone who thinks strategically, moves quickly, and likes getting things live. You’ll own growth across experimentation, analytics, SEO/AEO, social and creator distribution, earned media, and conversion.

The question we want you constantly asking is:

Where else can SkillCat grow?

**What You’ll Own**

Find new channels, audiences, partnerships, and growth opportunities. Launch quickly, learn, kill what isn’t working, and scale what is.

Social, Creators & Distribution: Build organic growth engines across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, LinkedIn, creators, influencers, ambassadors, communities, partnerships, and emerging platforms. Develop ideas and programs capable of reaching millions of people without relying primarily on paid media.

Earned Attention: Find stories worth talking about. Build relationships with creators, journalists, communities, and partners, and create reasons for people to talk about SkillCat.

Analytics & Conversion: Understand what is driving growth, investigate dips and spikes, measure experiments, find friction in the funnel, and turn data into action.

SEO & AEO: Own the strategy for how SkillCat gets discovered across Google, ChatGPT, Gemini, and other search platforms. Identify opportunities, set priorities, and work closely with outside experts to execute.

**What We’re Looking For**

You’ll probably thrive here if you:

* Have personally helped grow a consumer product, audience, community, or brand
* Have run growth experiments across multiple channels, not just paid acquisition
* Have built organic distribution through social, creators, influencers, UGC, ambassadors, communities, or partnerships
* Understand what makes ideas and content spread across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms
* Are highly analytical and comfortable digging into funnels, performance, and experiment results
* Understand SEO and AEO well enough to identify opportunities, set priorities, and effectively manage outside experts
* Move quickly and have a strong bias toward action
* Are relentlessly curious about new channels, tools, trends, and growth opportunities
* Are obsessed with understanding customers
* Are resourceful and comfortable figuring things out yourself
* Use AI and automation naturally in your work
* Understand internet culture, creators, communities, and modern distribution
* Are comfortable cold emailing, DMing, calling, pitching, and building relationships
* Take ownership without waiting for someone to tell you what to do.
* This Is a Hands-On Role. We are not looking for someone who only manages agencies, teams, or strategy.

You should be willing to write the copy, pull the data, talk to customers, build the scrappy landing page, learn the new tool, DM the creator, pitch the journalist, or launch the experiment yourself when that is the fastest way to learn.

You should be equally comfortable deciding what we should do and rolling up your sleeves to make it happen.

**Head of Growth Marketing**
============================

**Location:** San Francisco Bay Area - 3-5 days in office

**About FullEnrich:**
---------------------

Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem with waterfall enrichment: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster.

What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted B2B data layer powering modern revenue teams and AI-driven workflows alike. Today, more than 5,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.

Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.

**The Role:**
-------------

You'll be joining as our Head of Growth Marketing, reporting directly to our CMO.

FullEnrich is growing rapidly, driven by a strong product-led growth motion and a successful creator program. As we enter our next stage of growth, we're looking for someone to build and own our growth marketing function, scaling the channels that already work while identifying new opportunities to reach and convert high-value customers.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst, Go to Market (GTM) FP&A - (West)
jobs.desc:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

In 2005, Smartsheet was founded on the idea that teams and millions of people worldwide deserve a better way to achieve their very best work. Today, we provide a leading cloud-based platform for work execution, empowering organizations to plan, capture, track, automate, and report on work at scale, resulting in more efficient processes and better results.

Smartsheet is growing its outstanding Finance team to help achieve our operational and financial goals while embodying our values. The Finance team connects the dots between Smartsheet's operational and business strategies to shape near and long term financial performance.

Our Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team is seeking a highly motivated and analytical Financial Analyst to support Go to Market Sales. This is a high-visibility role, requiring effective communication and strong relationship-building skills. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in supporting decision-making and enhancing our corporate processes for forecasting, budgeting, and reporting.

This role will report to our Senior Manager of FP&A located in our Bellevue, WA office. Role is remote eligible.

You Will:

  • Oversee daily rhythms for your areas of support across GTM Sales and Finance to promote functional excellence and top-line growth
  • Contribute to the annual planning and quarterly forecast, along with variance analysis cycles
  • Partner with GTM Sales teams to align resource allocation with budget and financial targets; improve forecast accuracy and accountability
  • Become the subject matter expert on sales org structures and reporting
  • Partner with Revenue Operations to drive alignment and outcomes within the Sales organizations
  • Collaborate across GTM, Finance, and Business Intelligence to identify insights that increase growth and improve profitability; Explain findings into high-quality communications and help implement recommendations
  • Develop and refine models and other frameworks, such as Bookings (product & services), Rep Productivity, & Commissions
  • Contribute to ad-hoc analysis and presentations to guide our decisions & support partner needs
  • Oversee month-end close activities and maintain accuracy of financial reporting by partnering with Accounting
  • Other duties as assigned

You Have: 

  • 3+ years of progressive experience and demonstrated growth in Finance/FP&A positions
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or economics preferred 
  • Exposure to SaaS subscription-based business models and associated KPIs a plus
  • Experience with NetSuite a plus
  • Experience with planning applications like Planful, Adaptive Insights, or Anaplan a plus
  • Strong understanding of financial modeling and analysis with proficiency in financial statements, cash flow analysis, and reporting
  • Talent for developing visual representation of financial/statistical data and telling the story of the financials
  • Excellent verbal & written communication skills with the ability to facilitate discussions with leaders
  • General excitement for data/BI and deep curiosity for leveraging systems to work more efficiently

jobs.desc:
Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. jobs.title: Events & Field Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
We are looking for an Events & Field Marketing Manager to own Toggl's presence made physical, the person who turns a conference badge, a booth conversation, or a dinner reservation into real business.

The salary for this position is €70,000 annually, and we are committed to reviewing salaries every year based on company and individual performance.

You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-5 and UTC+2. This role runs events on both sides of the Atlantic, so you'll need to be able to travel to both North America and Europe.

 

Overview

We believe, now more than ever, that in-person moments cut through marketing noise in a way nothing digital can: a handshake, a shared meal, a five-minute conversation where someone finally "gets it." This role is responsible for engineering those moments on purpose, again and again, and ensuring they don't evaporate the second the event ends.

You are someone who has done this before (preferably in a B2B SaaS setting) and can negotiate a vendor contract in the morning, rewrite an invitation email by lunch, and walk a trade show floor in the afternoon, reading which conversations are worth a follow-up call.

 

The role

As Events & Field Marketing Manager, you own the full lifecycle of Toggl's in-person and hybrid presence, turning sponsorships, trade shows, and owned experiences into a genuine pipeline engine, not just a brand awareness play.

Your main responsibilities will be:

  • Sponsored event execution: Take full, end-to-end operational coordination ownership for all major external sponsorships and industry trade shows. You'll manage vendor communications, booth layout architecture, graphic dimension configurations, compliance logistics, and swag sourcing & distribution, owning the event budget and negotiating with vendors along the way.

  • Event content & communications: Write and produce all content required to run an event end-to-end — invitations, landing pages, promotional emails, social posts, on-site materials, and post-event follow-up sequences. You'll also create post-event recap content (summary emails, LinkedIn posts, short highlight videos, and case studies where relevant) to extend the life of each event well beyond its final day.

  • Pipeline coordination: Eliminate post-event pipeline latency by building strict cross-departmental SLAs before any event takes place. You'll work directly with Sales and our Demand Gen Manager to build pre-event ad layers, account matching lists, and post-event outbound sequencing so event contacts are in active sales conversations within 24 hours.

  • Owned experiential events: Research, conceptualize, and execute curated physical event touchpoints (think micro-roundtables and private VIP executive dinners) specifically designed for upmarket decision-makers, managing everything from venue negotiation and culinary curation to guest list outreach and on-site execution.

Other responsibilities include:

  • Owning the event lead capture process and ensuring all attendee data flows cleanly into HubSpot with correct source attribution.

  • Reporting on cost-per-opportunity for each activation to showcase the impact of event and field marketing activities.

  • Collaborating with Marketing and Sales to align event initiatives with overall pipeline and business goals.

  • Using AI tools extensively in your daily work for research, synthesis, analysis, drafting, and exploration. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact.

Department: Owner Relations / Owner Experience
Market: Puerto Vallarta & Nuevo Vallarta, Mexico

Position Purpose

The Owner Experience Specialist is the primary point of contact between Naya Homes and our homeowners in Puerto Vallarta and Nuevo Vallarta.

This role is responsible for building and maintaining strong, consistent, and proactive relationships with homeowners in order to support owner satisfaction and retention. Rather than simply reacting to problems after they occur, the Specialist is expected to identify potential concerns early and address them before they become reasons for an owner to consider terminating their relationship with Naya Homes.

The Specialist owns three key outcomes: executing the required owner communication cadence under the 33-Touch Relationship Model; providing homeowners with clear visibility into the condition and performance of their properties; and capturing property content that supports marketing efforts, social media, and owner communication.

Description

CRM Marketing Manager

Reporting to: CMO
Location: Fully Remote
Markets: 12

About the Role

We are looking for a CRM Marketing Manager to own CXM’s customer lifecycle marketing across 12 markets. You will use customer data, segmentation, automation, and personalised communications to improve activation, first-time deposits, retention, reactivation, and customer lifetime value.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can build CRM journeys from the ground up, manage campaigns across multiple markets, and use performance data to continuously improve results.

Key Objectives

  • Build and launch at least 3 automated lifecycle journeys covering welcome/activation, retention, and reactivation within the first 6 months.
  • Improve the current 9% lead-to-FTD conversion rate through targeted CRM activation campaigns.
  • Support reducing churn to below 10% through structured retention and reactivation programmes.
  • Build and maintain localised CRM journeys across all 12 markets.
  • Maintain 99%+ deliverability and ensure all CRM activity meets applicable compliance requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Lifecycle & CRM Strategy

  • Own customer journeys across onboarding, activation, conversion, retention, loyalty, VIP, churn prevention, and win-back.
  • Define triggers, audiences, journey logic, exclusions, frequency caps, and exit criteria.
  • Coordinate email and push communications to create a consistent customer experience.

Campaigns & Automation

  • Build, launch, and optimise automated CRM campaigns using platforms such as Mailgun, Braze, Klaviyo, or equivalent.
  • Create targeted campaigns based on customer behaviour, lifecycle stage, market, language, and product.
  • Manage promotional campaigns, newsletters, VIP communications, retention campaigns, and partner communications.
  • Develop and maintain reusable email templates and content blocks.

Segmentation & Personalisation

  • Build and maintain customer segments, consent lists, exclusions, and communication rules.
  • Configure personalised and dynamic content based on customer data.
  • Work with Product, Analytics, and IT to define and validate data and event requirements.
  • SQL knowledge is a strong advantage.

Localisation

  • Manage CRM communications across multiple languages and markets.
  • Coordinate translation, editing, and linguistic QA.
  • Ensure correct currencies, dates, links, variables, legal messaging, tone, and RTL requirements.
  • Maintain master journeys and localisation matrices across all markets.

Deliverability & Compliance

  • Monitor deliverability, bounces, spam complaints, suppression lists, and domain/IP reputation.
  • Maintain strong email hygiene and deliverability standards.
  • Run detailed pre-launch QA covering audiences, links, variables, tracking, content, sender details, and scheduling.
  • Ensure campaigns comply with consent, unsubscribe, data retention, and local regulatory requirements.

Analytics & Optimisation

  • Analyse CRM performance by market, language, segment, and customer lifecycle stage.
  • Measure conversion, retention, churn, revenue, and incremental uplift — not just opens and clicks.
  • Run A/B and holdout tests across offers, messaging, timing, frequency, channels, and journey structure.
  • Maintain a clear optimisation backlog and turn insights into measurable improvements.


Requirements
  • Proven experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, email marketing, or marketing auto

jobs.title: Marketing Manager – Social Media (Instagram & TikTok)
jobs.desc:
We're XO Angels, a creator management agency. As a Growth Manager, you'll own the short-form strategy of 2-4 creators end to end: scripts, shot lists, feedback to creators and editors, and constant testing until the numbers move. Your only real goal: views that turn into real reach.

What you'll actually do

  • Analyse viral short-form content, understand why it worked, and adapt it for our creators.
  • Write scripts and shot lists that your creators then shoot. Give them precise feedback on what worked, what didn't, and what needs to change.
  • Direct editors and posters. You own the output, they execute it.
  • Analyse every post: why did this hit, why did that flop, what do we double down on this week.
  • Test bold ideas fast, kill what doesn't work, scale what does.

Who we're looking for
This is not a 9-to-5. When a Reel goes viral on a Sunday night, you're on it. When an account gets banned at 10pm on a weekday, you handle it. Weekends are normally off, but when there's an emergency you step in, no discussion. If that puts you off, this role isn't for you.

We want:

  • Obsession with short-form. You watch TikTok and Reels for hours voluntarily and can explain why a video works. You're not learning this, you already live it.
  • Ownership mindset. You treat your creators' accounts like your own business. No excuses, no "the editor didn't deliver", you make it happen.
  • Analytical eye. You can look at 20 videos and tell us what pattern connects the winners.
  • Fluent English. Non-negotiable.
  • Bonus, not required: experience growing IG or TikTok accounts, agency or marketing background. We care more about drive and taste than about your CV.

What you get

  • 3,000 USD base + performance bonuses. Realistic total 3,500-7,000 USD/month depending on results.
  • 100% remote. Work from wherever.
  • Direct impact. Small team, no bureaucracy. Your ideas ship this week, not next quarter.
  • Clear path up. If you really push, you can become Head of Marketing within 12-18 months and lead your own team.

How to apply
Click the link and fill out the short application. It tells you honestly what the role really involves, and screens you in or out, so neither you nor we waste any time.

jobs.desc:
Emergent builds autonomous coding agents that replace traditional software development by generating, testing, and deploying production applications directly from plain-language intent. Our systems run in production at global scale and are used to build millions of real applications.

Since our public launch, we've crossed $130M in Annualised Revenue and grown to over 10M users across 190+ countries , who have built 12M+ applications on Emergent. We're backed by Creaegis, Khosla Ventures, SoftBank, Lightspeed, Together, Y Combinator, Google, Claypond and Sentinel Global.

We're hiring builders who want ownership, speed, and impact at global scale.

The Role:
About 70% of our users have never coded before. They are small business owners, solo founders, and operators who had an idea and no engineer to build it with. We are hiring a writer to run the words across our social channels. You will write the day-to-day content that goes out on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, and LinkedIn: short-form video scripts, captions, on-screen text, threads, community posts, and replies from the brand account.

Most of our audience is in the US and Europe. You should be comfortable writing for those markets without needing anyone to explain the reference. This is a full-time role based in Bangalore, reporting to the Head of Brand and Marketing.

What You'll Do:

  • Write short-form video scripts and captions for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube on a daily cadence
  • Write posts and threads for X and LinkedIn
  • Spot trends, formats, and news moments early and turn them into content while they are still relevant, usually within 48 hours
  • Decide which trends are worth joining and which ones to leave alone
  • Build content ideas that people want to participate in, share, or argue with, rather than only consume
  • Run the brand account's replies and comment sections
  • Find real users who have built something with Emergent and turn their stories into content
  • Work with the design and video team so scripts are written for what can actually be produced
  • Track what worked, share it with the team, and change the approach when the numbers say so

What We're Looking For:

  • At least 5 years writing and managing content for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, and LinkedIn
  • A body of work that performed, with the numbers to show it
  • Strong understanding of internet culture in the US and Europe
  • Ability to work fast and make calls without waiting for sign-off
  • Comfort writing differently for each platform

Benefits and Perks:

  1. Daily Meals: Lunch and Dinner provided
  2. Family Insurance: 5 Lakhs worth of coverage for you and your family
  3. Unlimited Paid Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge and come back refreshed
  4. Flexible Working Hours: Work arrangements that fit your life and commitments
