jobs.title: Marketing Manager, AI and Lifecycle
jobs.desc:
Company: Rove Next, by Rove Concepts
Location: Remote. Open across the Americas and Europe.
Hours: Full-time overlap with Pacific or Eastern time. This is a requirement, not a preference.
Type: Independent contractor, full time
Apply: [talent@rovenext.com]

About the role

Rove Next is a new premium line from Rove Concepts, a Vancouver-based modern furniture brand selling direct to consumer across Canada and the US. Rove Next launches with improved versions of our best-selling pieces, and it needs its own marketing built from the ground up.

That's this role. You'll own how Rove Next reaches customers and keeps them, starting with email and lifecycle. The goal is a marketing function that scales through AI and systems rather than through headcount, and the advantage here is that you're building it clean rather than inheriting one.

This is not a coordination role. We need someone who takes a problem and builds the answer, and who catches things before they reach leadership.

Scope

Initially focused on Rove Next, with room to expand across the Rove Concepts group as the brand grows.

What you'll own

Email and lifecycle as our primary owned channel. Campaign calendar, flows, segmentation, deliverability, list health. We run on Klaviyo.

Quality control on everything that ships. Copy, creative, link destinations, offers, regional versions. If something goes out wrong, it was yours to catch.

Building AI into the daily work. Not proposing it, shipping it.

Working alongside our lifecycle and email team, our designers, and our external ads partner to keep the calendar moving.

Translating results into plain business language. What we spent, what we made, what we'd do differently.

Must-haves

Five or more years in ecommerce or DTC marketing with real ownership of email and lifecycle. Klaviyo or a comparable ESP.

Evidence that you build with AI yourself rather than assigning it. When you hit a wall, your instinct should be to build through it, not to raise a ticket and wait.

Fluent, native-level English, written and spoken. This one is non-negotiable. You will be writing copy that goes out to our customers under our name, so we need someone who can hear the difference between a line that sounds premium and one that sounds like a discount retailer.

A strong eye. You can look at an asset and tell whether the destination matches the promise, whether the tone is right, and whether the offer math actually adds up.

Comfortable being told when something isn't landing, and comfortable telling us the same.

Nice to have

Furniture, home, or another considered-purchase category with a long buying cycle. Shopify, GA4 and Meta Ads familiarity. Experience holding a team to brand guidelines.

What success looks like

Flow revenue grows as a share of total email revenue. Work stops reaching leadership with errors in it. AI is doing measurable work inside the function within 90 days, rather than sitting in a proposal.

Compensation

$3,500 to $4,500 USD per month depending on experience. Independent contractor.

How to apply

Send your CV to [talent@rovenext.com]. In a few lines, tell us two things:

One AI workflow or automation you built yourself in a real business. What it did, and what it saved.

One time you caught something before it shipped that nobody else had noticed.

Please also include a short voice note, around 60 seconds, introducing yourself and telling us what you'd want to know before writing your first email for us.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short paid project.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
**HIGHER!** is a new business branch of Crypto Banter on **a mission to help people change their lives** through dopamine-fueled, 1-7 day challenges across crypto, AI, trading & beyond.

Our challenges guide achievers through step-by-step transformations, checkpoint by checkpoint, delivering real wins and fast results. We’re building a community of achievers who level up together. We’re in the early stages and scaling rapidly. Our first challenge proved that the model works. Now, we’re expanding across multiple categories and hosts. As a new vertical, we focus on user acquisition beyond Crypto Banter’s current audience, challenges creation, and building a thriving community.

Everything we do is about helping people change their lives. **Let’s go HIGHER!**

### **Role Overview**

We're looking for an analytical, numbers-driven **Growth Marketing Manager** to own the performance and execution of our Meta Ads strategy. You'll be responsible for scaling HIGHER! beyond our existing audience by masterminding end-to-end campaigns on Meta. You aren't just managing budgets. You're a creative strategist who knows how to warm up cold traffic through sophisticated funnels, from the initial scroll-stopping ad to the final product conversion.

### **What you'll do**

  

* **Own the full-funnel architecture:** Design and own the entire user journey, from paid acquisition strategy through to the channels and funnels that support the challenge business. This means building end-to-end campaigns, high-converting landing pages and email sequences that carry a lead all the way to sign-up.
* **Lead creative quality control:** Own the hooks, angles and core performance copy. We don't run generic ads. You'll have a sharp eye for what makes creative work, partnering with designers and editors so every ad lands with the psychology of the target audience.
* **Drive performance and ROI:** Be fully accountable for the commercial outcome of your spend. You'll track metrics daily to make sure we're generating revenue rather than burning cash, shifting budget and tweaking funnel logic based on hard data.
* **Set the audience strategy:** Own the thinking behind the traffic. Identify new audience segments, run the warming strategy for our existing audience, and understand what someone is thinking when they click and how to move them through the funnel (simple quizzes, commitment hooks) to maximise conversion.
* **Execute lifecycle journeys:** Make the transition from Meta lead to challenge participant seamless. Own the tools and tracking that keep users engaged from first click through to the final product.

### **Your skills and experience**

  

* **Meta Ads specialist:** deep, hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and a proven track record of scaling paid spend for info-products, webinars or digital challenges.
* **Info-product mindset:** you understand the story-driven nature of selling a challenge or transformation versus a standard SaaS product, and how to use urgency and value to drive sign-ups.
* **Analytical and numbers-driven:** you live in analytics and base every decision on data. You can spot a leak in the funnel before it hits the bottom line.
* **Technical funnel builder:** comfortable with Typeform, landing page builders and CRM software to build the infrastructure behind your funnels.
* **Creative strategist:** you can spot a generic ad from a mile away. You know how to brief and iterate on high-performance creative that stops the scroll and converts.
* **Category experience:** you've worked with audiences and campaigns across finance, crypto, trading, e-products or ecommerce.
* **Direct communicator:** you write and speak clearly in UK English, have a bias to action and thrive in a lean, high-output team where you own the results.

**Nice to have**

* Understanding of search/SEO and Google campaigns
* Exchange experience
* Understanding of trading

**Position Type:** Full-Time

**About Apex Service Partners**

Apex Service Partners is a leading residential HVAC, Plumbing, and Electrical services organization focused on building market-leading local brands across the country. We are committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences, operational excellence, and meaningful career growth opportunities for our team members.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a results-oriented Marketing Manager to support five service locations across the Baltimore market area. This role oversees approximately **$42M in annual revenue and a $3M marketing budget**, driving lead generation, customer acquisition, brand visibility, and marketing performance across multiple brands and markets.

The ideal candidate is a strategic and analytical marketer who understands how to turn marketing investments into measurable business results. This individual will partner closely with General Managers, regional leadership, internal marketing teams, and agency partners to maximize revenue growth and return on marketing investment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute local and regional marketing strategies that drive revenue growth, lead generation, and market share expansion.
* Manage and optimize marketing investments across PPC, SEO, Local Services Ads (LSA), paid social, digital advertising, community engagement, and other marketing channels.
* Partner with General Managers to align marketing initiatives with local business objectives and operational capacity.
* Manage a marketing budget of approximately $3M, making data-driven investment decisions to maximize ROI and ROAS.
* Analyze marketing performance metrics, including lead volume, conversion rates, booking rates, customer acquisition costs, and revenue impact.
* Lead agency and vendor relationships, holding partners accountable to performance goals and agreed-upon KPIs.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer insights to identify opportunities for growth.
* Ensure brand consistency and strong local market presence across all supported locations.
* Present performance results and strategic recommendations to operational and executive leadership teams.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field preferred.
* 5+ years of marketing management experience, preferably supporting multiple locations or brands.
* Strong expertise in digital marketing, including PPC, SEO, Local Services Ads (LSA), paid media, and lead generation.
* Experience managing significant marketing budgets and evaluating ROI through data and analytics.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively with operations leaders, field teams, agencies, and external partners.
* Strong communication, presentation, and analytical skills.
* Experience in home services, skilled trades, franchise, or multi-location marketing environments is highly preferred.

**What Makes You Successful**

* You think like a business owner and focus on measurable outcomes.
* You are highly accountable and driven by results.
* You use data to guide decisions and optimize performance.
* You build credibility with operators, leadership teams, and agency partners.
* You thrive in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

* Revenue Growth

* Cost Per Lead (CPL)
* Cost Per Booking
* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
* Lead-to-Booking Conversion Rate
* Market Share Growth

* Agency and Vendor Performance

**Join Apex Service Partners and help drive growth across five leading HVAC, Plumbing, and Electrical service brands while building best-in-class marketing programs that deliver measurable business results.**

Small team. High trust. Direct feedback. We test ideas quickly and keep only what works. We care about creative quality and commercial results in equal measure.

Why this role exists

The fact that we have grown to around 1 million/year revenue without a marketing leader/expert shows that we have a compelling product and offer, but we need a growth marketing rockstar to take us to the next level.

Jason is the face and heart of the brand. He also becomes a bottleneck when he has to review every subject line and landing page. We need a senior leader who can own growth end to end, partner with Jason on positioning and creative, and free him to focus on product, content, and teaching.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You set the strategy and you run the plays yourself, across both B2C (individual creatives) and B2B (agencies that care about fast ROI and clear outcomes).

* An amazing product with rave 5-star reviews
* Very little competition
* Strong brand awareness and reputation
* A famous face and name in the industry
* Strong growth despite not having a marketing leader, and despite having very incomplete and rudimentary marketing thus far

You will own revenue growth across the full funnel. Set the strategy, run the plays, and build a small team that can execute with speed.

* Steady month-over-month growth in qualified demand from both individuals and agencies.
* Improved conversion at each step of the funnel, from ad to webinar to purchase.
* A clear read on CAC, LTV, and payback that informs every spend decision.

**Twin Health**

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person's metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

**Working here**

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights' Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek's Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

**Opportunity**

Today, Twin Health does almost no proactive marketing to our active members. Once someone enrolls, nearly every communication they receive is either a product-triggered push notification or a message from their care team. That has taken us a long way — but it leaves an entire layer of engagement unbuilt.

We are hiring our first Active Member Marketing Manager to build that layer. You will own the strategy and the execution of every proactive, non-clinically led communication a Twin member receives: email, SMS, in-app and push campaigns, direct mail testing, member webinars, and additional channel exploration we have not yet tried. You will design how those communications layer into the care team relationship and the product notification ecosystem already in place.

This is a build role requiring both strategic vision as well as executional know how. Twin members, data, clinical outcomes, and Braze infrastructure is already in place. What does not exist is a deliberate lifecycle program. You will write the strategy, then ship it yourself. We are looking for someone who can point to campaigns they personally built and outcomes they personally moved.

**Responsibilities**

Active Member Strategy and Program Ownership

* Map the member journey to build sustained engagement, as well as winback for lapsed members, and define the communication strategy for each stage, including who we deliberately choose not to message.
* Own the annual and quarterly engagement roadmap, with a defined direction on stage involvement
* Build a segmentation model grounded in real member behavior, sensors, app engagement, care team interaction, clinical trajectory, enrollment channels, etc.
* Govern the member communication calendar across marketing, care team, product, and clinical, so members experience one coherent voice instead of four uncoordinated ones.

Integration with the Care Team and Product Ecosystem

* Inventory the existing touchpoint landscape and maintain that map as the source of truth.
* Partner with Care Delivery and Clinical leadership to define the boundary between a marketing communication and a clinical one. Member marketing should make the care team more effective, not compete with it for attention.

jobs.title: SEO Specialist (Google Ads Experience a Plus)
jobs.desc:
**SEO-focused role. Google Ads experience is a plus.**

This is an SEO job first. We need someone who knows how to get established businesses found on Google, and increasingly in AI search tools, by people who are ready to buy. If you can also build and manage Google Ads campaigns, you'll be even more valuable here.

**About The Digital MC**

The Digital MC is a digital marketing and web agency based in Northern Kentucky. We work with established companies, usually doing $1M to $50M a year: contractors, remodelers, manufacturers, financial firms, government contractors and other businesses that have real customers and want a better way to get more of them.

We start with strategy and do the execution second. Before we write content or launch a campaign, we figure out who the customer is, how they search, what they need to see before they reach out, and whether the website is doing its job. Then we do the work. You won't be cranking out blog posts to hit a quota. Everything you do will have a clear reason behind it.

We're a small team, so your work will be seen and it will matter.

**What You'll Do**

SEO is about 75% or more of the job:

* Run technical SEO audits and fix what you find, including crawl issues, indexing, site speed, redirects, schema and internal linking
* Do keyword research and map it to what searchers want, so every page has a clear job
* Plan and optimize service pages, location pages and supporting content
* Write or edit on-page copy, title tags and meta descriptions that read like a person wrote them
* Manage and improve Google Business Profiles for local clients
* Help plan redirects and protect rankings when we launch new websites
* Keep up with how AI search (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity) is changing what gets surfaced, and adjust our approach
* Track results in Search Console and GA4 and explain them in plain language for monthly client reports

PPC is the rest, and it grows as your skills do:

* Help build and manage Google Ads search campaigns, and Local Service Ads for eligible clients
* Review search terms, add negative keywords and help with budget and bid decisions
* Write ad copy and flag when a landing page is hurting results
* Help set up and check conversion tracking in Google Tag Manager

**What We're Looking For**

* 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, at an agency or in-house
* Comfortable working in WordPress (Shopify experience is a bonus)
* Solid working knowledge of Google Search Console, GA4 and at least one SEO platform such as Semrush, Ahrefs or Screaming Frog
* A real understanding of local SEO and how Google Maps rankings work
* You write clearly. You can explain to a business owner why a ranking dropped without hiding behind jargon.
* You can manage your own time and stay on top of several clients without anyone looking over your shoulder
* You communicate well in writing and keep people updated without being asked
* You care about whether the work produced leads, not just whether rankings went up

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on Google Ads experience (Google Ads certification is a plus)
* Local Service Ads or Meta Ads experience
* Experience with Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking
* Basic HTML/CSS, enough to fix things without waiting on a developer
* Experience with home services, construction or B2B clients

**Why Work Here**

* Fully remote
* Direct access to the founder and a front-row seat to how agency strategy gets built
* A wide range of industries and problems to work on, so you won't get bored
* Room to grow into a larger search marketing role as the agency grows

Pay: $45,000.00 - $60,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Cincinnati, OH 45202

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
**About AiPrise**
=================

AiPrise is the global compliance platform for companies that operate across borders. We cover the full KYB lifecycle in a single API, with AI agents handling the case work that used to eat analyst hours. Customers include Meta, Bridge (a Stripe company), Airwallex, Fireblocks, and Nivoda. We're a YC company (S22), Series A backed by Headline, and growing fast.

**About this role**
===================

We're looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to own paid media at AiPrise, end to end.  
LinkedIn is our proven channel. Google runs brand search today. Meta, Reddit, TV, radio, and channels we haven't named yet are on the list to test. You'll run all of it: the platforms, the creative, the budgets, the tests, and the reporting.

Our audience is compliance leaders at fintech, payments, stablecoin, and marketplace companies. It's a small audience by paid media standards, which means precision beats volume, and every dollar gets judged on pipeline, not clicks.

This is a hands-on role with real authority. You set the approach: how much a test needs to be conclusive, when to stop it, and when to scale it. Then you report what happened, every week, in plain numbers. You report to the Head of Marketing and work closely with our Growth Marketing Manager, as well as sales, product marketing, content, and design.

**What you'll own**
===================

* Every paid platform: LinkedIn, Google, Meta, Reddit, and offline tests including TV and radio. Strategy, setup, targeting, budgets, bidding, and optimization, hands on keyboard.
* The test program. A budget, a hypothesis, and a verdict date for every test. Kill fast, scale what works, and put the decision in writing.
* Creative, from concept to live ad. You develop the angles, write the copy, brief design and video on the assets, and iterate on what the numbers say. Buyer language over marketing language.
* Weekly reporting: spend, leads, SQLs, pipeline, and cost per SQL by channel and by test. Honest, sourced, reproducible.
* Account-based campaigns: paid programs against named target accounts, coordinated with sales.
* Event campaigns: pre-event targeting and post-event retargeting across our conference calendar.
* What happens after the click: landing pages and forms that match the ad and convert, working with web and content.

**Who you are**
===============

* 4+ years running paid campaigns for B2B, with hands-on platform experience across at least three of LinkedIn, Google, Meta, and Reddit.
* You've managed monthly paid budgets between $20K and $100K and can show what they produced.
* You know the platforms cold: campaign structure, audiences, bidding, conversion tracking, and the settings most people leave on default.
* You can take a concept from a sentence to a live ad: the angle, the copy, the creative brief, the landing page ask, and the test design around it.
* You think in pipeline, not impressions. Comfortable in HubSpot or an equivalent CRM, spreadsheets, and attribution data, and you know when the numbers are lying.
* You set the approach. You've sized test budgets, called tests early when they were failing, and scaled winners without being told to.
* You use AI tools every day for creative development and analysis. This is a requirement, not a nice to have.
* You treat accuracy as non-negotiable. Every number you report is sourced and reproducible. This is a hard requirement, not a preference.
* You write clearly and work well remotely. Your weekly update should be readable by a founder in two minutes.
* High ownership, high autonomy, fast pace, and real care about the quality of what ships.

**Nice to have**
================

* Offline media experience: TV, radio, out-of-home, or podcast advertising, including how to measure it.
* Experience with account-based marketing programs.
* Experience marketing to compliance, risk, or fintech buyers.

* Monitor pacing, performance, and ROI, and reallocate spend dynamically based on results, seasonality, and business needs.
* Partner with Finance and agency teams to support forecasting, scenario planning, and in-flight budget optimization.

Campaign Execution & Optimization
  

* Lead day-to-day performance management of campaigns in partnership with agency teams, ensuring strong pacing, optimization, and results.

**We are ideally looking for one hybrid employee located in Richmond, Virginia, or one Remote employee in the states of Virginia, Ohio, Illinois, North Carolina, New York, Colorado, Texas, or California.**

### **About Us**

Workshop Digital is a results-oriented **digital marketing agency** based in Richmond, Virginia, committed to building strong, lasting partnerships with our clients. For over a decade, we’ve championed transparency and collaboration to deliver measurable results that help businesses grow.

We act as an extension of our clients’ marketing teams, developing customized digital marketing strategies aligned with their unique goals and services.

Our team of experienced digital marketing analysts works side-by-side with clients to gain a deeper understanding of their business, industry, and competitors. By identifying ideal target audiences and uncovering what sets our clients apart, we help their brands stand out and achieve meaningful, measurable impact.

### **Position Purpose**

The Growth Marketing Manager partners with the CEO and leadership team to define Workshop Digital's marketing strategy and is responsible for increasing Workshop’s brand visibility and driving qualified pipeline for the Business Development team. The Growth Marketing Manager builds and executes the annual marketing plan, stewards the Workshop Digital brand, and manages the Marketing Coordinator. This role is both strategic and hands-on: they set the direction for internal marketing and personally deliver key pieces, while growing the coordinator's ownership of day-to-day execution.

### **Position Summary**

The Growth Marketing Manager supports the company by:

* Advising the CEO and Leadership Team proactively on marketing strategy, positioning, and growth opportunities
* Building and owning the annual marketing plan, quarterly goals, and marketing budget
* Leading, managing, and developing the Marketing Coordinator function
* Generating marketing-sourced pipeline and partnering with Business Development to convert it into revenue
* Stewarding the Workshop Digital brand, messaging, and positioning across every channel
* Leading content, thought leadership, and sales enablement efforts that showcase our expertise and client results
* Owning marketing operations, including CRM, marketing automation, attribution, and reporting
* Supporting recruitment marketing that positions Workshop Digital as a best place to work
* Maintaining a pulse on industry trends, competitors, and emerging channels, including AI search

### **Responsibilities**

### **LEAD, MANAGE, AND HOLD TEAM ACCOUNTABLE (LMA)**

* Directly manage the Marketing Coordinator, setting clear weekly and quarterly priorities
* Define personal and professional development goals for direct reports and track progress towards reaching them
* Conduct effective one-on-ones, team meetings, and quarterly check-ins with direct reports, providing ongoing feedback, coaching, and support
* Review the coordinator's work for quality, accuracy, and brand alignment before it goes live
* Identify opportunities for the coordinator to take greater ownership and accountability for processes and channels

* Tactfully share feedback with colleagues
* Partner with Business Development, Client Services, and department leads to align marketing with company objectives
* Recruit internal subject matter experts to contribute to content, webinars, and speaking opportunities

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
**About Improvado**
-------------------

Improvado is a marketing data and AI analytics platform for enterprise brands and agencies. We connect 500+ marketing and sales data sources, normalize them through a governed data model, and put an AI agent on top so marketing teams can ask questions of their own data without going through BI or IT.

**What we sell:** extraction and 500+ connectors; data transformation (SQL and dbt-compatible); Marketing Data Governance — taxonomy, naming, data-quality rules; warehouse and storage; dashboards; AI agent and MCP access to live marketing data; DECS, data engineering as a service on a 2 to 4 week SLA.

**Who buys it:**

* *Economic buyers:* CMO, VP Marketing, VP Demand Gen, agency COO and ops leadership
* *Technical evaluators:* VP or Director of Marketing Analytics, marketing analysts, data engineering, sometimes IT and security
* *Segments:* enterprise brands, mid-market, agencies
* *Verticals:* pharma and healthcare, financial services, retail and eCommerce, gaming, agencies

**Why this role, now**
----------------------

* **Our messaging is not aligned.** Positioning, web, sales pitch, product and content each carry a different version of what Improvado is. The market categorizes us as "marketing ETL" while we position as an AI marketing analytics platform. That gap costs us deal quality and price.
* **The category is crowded and moving fast.** Battlecards exist but decay, and nobody owns keeping them true.
* **Attribution, incrementality and causal measurement is where deals are won and lost** — and it is the hardest thing to argue credibly without hand-waving.
* **Analyst firms are a silent blocker.** When an enterprise buyer asks Gartner or Forrester about Improvado, there is no briefed narrative waiting for them.

You would not start from a blank page. We already have a positioning registry, roughly 11 documented buyer personas, a pain-point and value-prop library, competitor intel reports and about 10 battlecards. They are inconsistent and under-used. Your first job is to make one version true and make people use it.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* **Positioning and messaging.** Core positioning, category framing and message hierarchy across ICPs and personas. ICP and persona documentation that is used, not filed. The messaging layer of new product and feature launches, including the internal rollout that makes the field able to sell it.
* **Competitive intelligence and win/loss.** A structured win/loss interview program with quarterly readouts. Living battlecards. Monitoring competitor positioning, pricing and product moves, and driving our counter-positioning.
* **Sales enablement.** The core pitch narrative, demo storyline and objection-handling framework. The messaging components of new-rep onboarding. A standing weekly cadence with Sales leadership — not quarterly check-ins. Direct support on competitive and enterprise deals: RFPs, security and technical evaluations, displacement plays.
* **Market and analyst relations.** The Improvado narrative for Gartner, Forrester and category influencers, so that a buyer's analyst call becomes an accelerator rather than a blocker. Feeding structured market and buyer insight back into product prioritization.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 4 to 8 years in product marketing, or an equivalent blend of product marketing with marketing analytics, marketing or data ops, sales engineering, analytics consulting, or product management on a data product.
* Category fluency in marketing data and measurement: attribution models, incrementality testing, MMM, data governance and taxonomy, warehouses and ETL/ELT — including where each is honestly weak.
* B2B SaaS sold to marketing or data buyers. Marketing analytics, martech, measurement, CDP, BI and data-infrastructure vendors are the reference profile.
* Proof you have shipped, not just documented: positioning that changed the website and the pitch, battlecards

At Huckleberry, our purpose is simple yet powerful: to build life-changing products and experiences that help all families unlock everyday magic.

Today, more than 6.5 million families trust Huckleberry and our app to be their partner through parenthood. Real pediatric expertise works hand-in-hand with data science, AI, and behavioral science to provide support behind-the-scenes that guides every parent through their unique journey.

We believe every family should feel taken care of—which is why we’re growing quickly and expanding our product offerings to help every family thrive.

**About the Role**

  

We are hiring a Marketing Manager - Web to own conversion across Huckleberry's web experience — from the first visit through app install, free trial, and purchase. This is a 6 month, 40 hours per week, 1099 contract position.

You'll carry your own web conversion target that rolls up into our broader user acquisition goal, and you'll own the experimentation program that moves it. The work spans further than most CRO roles. You'll write build specs for interactive web tools, partner with our Guidance team to make sure anything we tell a parent is clinically sound, and build AI-driven systems that let a small team run a testing cadence that would otherwise take several people.

This role reports to the VP of Marketing on an interim basis and is expected to move under the Senior Director of User Acquisition and Growth once that role is filled. You'll work closely with Brand Editorial, Guidance, Engineering, Lifecycle Marketing, Partnerships, and User Acquisition.

### **Areas of Responsibility**

**Web Conversion & Experimentation**

* **Target Ownership**: Own a web conversion target that rolls up into our broader user acquisition goal, expressed as either acquisition or revenue depending on current company priority. When that expression changes, you re-point the roadmap without losing program continuity.

* **Readouts**: Deliver performance updates and test readouts to marketing leadership, publish quarterly web priorities, and contribute web reporting to executive and board updates.

**Interactive Web Experiences**

* **Concept to Spec**: Conceive, impact-size, and scope interactive web experiences — calculators, quizzes, guided recommendations — that demonstrate product value before signup. Write the engineering build specs: input and output logic, edge cases, handoff behavior, and event instrumentation.

* **Clinical Guardrails**: Anything that returns guidance to a parent requires Guidance team partnership by default. You'll work with them to set the thresholds and logic behind each tool, source recommendations to recognized pediatric guidelines, and make sure a "not yet" result lands supportively.

* **Monetization Discipline**: Surface scope and monetization risks early and drive them to a decision — including recommending against builds that would give away a paid in-app mechanic.

* **AI-Built Systems**: Our testing cadence runs at this scale because the recurring work is built into AI-driven systems. You'll maintain and extend those systems, and build new ones — with documented logic, edge-case handling, state tracking across runs, and human approval gates wherever judgment is required.

* **Measurement**: Partner with Business Analytics to shape how web performance is instrumented and reported. Specify event instrumentation for new experiences,

Foundation Software, a leading SaaS provider of construction accounting, estimating, payroll processing and field operations solutions, is hiring an **AEO/GEO Specialist** to strengthen our visibility across the answer engines that construction professionals utilize before ever reaching a traditional search results page. These include ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.

This role works within the parameters of our existing SEO strategy, partnering closely with our SEO Strategist, to ensure that organic, AI-answer, and paid visibility all pull in the same direction. This person owns AEO/GEO strategy day to day and reports to the Director of Paid Media for alignment on paid/organic messaging.

Sundays for Dogs is a founder-led brand reimagining pet food so dog owners can spend more quality time with their dogs—now and later. We make human-grade, air-dried food that supports long, healthy lives, and we're building a company that reflects how great teams should work: with low ego, high ownership, honest feedback, creative problem-solving, and a bias toward doing more with less.

Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, we're a distributed team of 60 full-time employees across the U.S. While we work remotely day-to-day, we gather quarterly in person because relationships matter. Our subscription-based DTC model is our foundation. We're entering an exciting growth stage—expanding our product assortment, driving innovation, and thoughtfully opening new channels. We're building to scale with intention, and we're just getting started.

**About your team and position:**

The Marketing team owns Sundays' full customer acquisition and growth engine, led by the VP of Growth Marketing. As we expand our product assortment and increase the pace of launch and seasonal activity, the team needs a dedicated owner for go-to-market execution and the integrated campaigns that surround it.

This is a net-new, individual contributor role. The **Go-to-Market Marketing Manager** will own the go-to-market plan for new products moving through Sundays' pipeline—from pricing and packaging through positioning and promotional launch—and will carry that work into market through integrated, multi-channel campaigns. This role functions similarly to a CPG brand manager, without full P&L responsibility: you'll drive the commercial and marketing decisions that shape how a product comes to market, while Finance retains ultimate accountability for margin and profitability. Brand strategy sits outside this role.

Every launch has two motions, and you'll own both: winning new customers, and moving our existing subscriber base. Most of what a launch actually ships is a product surface—PDPs, quiz placement, SKU and bundle setup, promo mechanics, portal flows—so you'll partner closely with Digital Product & Engineering and Analytics alongside R&D, Supply Chain, Creative, Retention, Operations, and Customer Care to translate a product concept into a launch-ready plan. You'll be the connective tissue ensuring every function is aligned on what's launching, when, and how.

Reports to: VP of Growth Marketing, with no direct reports. You'll work closely with Digital Product & Engineering, Analytics, R&D, Creative, Supply Chain/Operations, Retention, and Customer Care on a regular basis. This is a full-time, remote position with periodic travel to Cleveland.

**Your day-to-day:**

* Own the go-to-market plan for new product launches, from initial concept through launch and early performance.
* Define launch tiers so small bets ship in weeks and big bets get the full plan, and match each launch to the right level of investment.
* Plan the new customer motion for each launch: offer construction, quiz placement, landing pages and paid creative, first-order economics, and the effect on overall conversion rate.
* Plan the active subscriber motion for each launch: attach, upgrade and swap; portal and email surfaces; cannibalization of existing SKUs; incremental LTV; and a migration plan for anyone whose plan changes.
* Define pricing and packaging recommendations in partnership with R&D, Supply Chain, Digital Product, Creative, and Finance, balancing customer value with margin considerations.
* Write the merchandising and promotional inputs Creative and Digital Product build from—PDP content, quiz placement, SKU and bundle setup, promo mechanics, and portal flows.
* Define the measurement plan before launch—success criteria, the metrics we'll read, and how we'll read them—then report against it and turn findings into a repeatable go-to-market playbook.
* Coordinate launch and campaign timelines across Digital Product & Engineering, Analytics, R&D, Sup

**This is position is onsite 5 days per week in Highland, CA. There is no remote or hybrid options**.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
**About Hexmodal**

Hexmodal builds smart devices and a simple software platform that help facilities teams automate routine compliance testing, monitoring, and documentation. Our technology helps teams spend less time on manual rounds and more time on the maintenance work that keeps buildings operating safely. Today, Hexmodal supports more than 180 health systems across 48 states.

**The Mission**
---------------

We are hiring a Content Marketing Manager to build and run everything Hexmodal publishes.

Our buyer is a facilities manager or director at a hospital. Many of them were electricians, plumbers, or HVAC technicians before they moved into management. They are accountable for emergency lighting, fire extinguishers, cold storage, and room pressure across dozens of buildings, and for proving to a Joint Commission surveyor that every one of those tests actually happened. They are practical, mobile (not at their desks), short on time, and immediately suspicious of vendor-speak.

You will write for that person across four areas. Demand content, meaning the blog and our SEO program against the compliance questions our buyers genuinely search. Proof content, meaning customer case studies you source, interview, write, and get approved. Field and sales material, meaning conference presentations, speaking submissions, webinars, and the one-pagers and enablement assets our sales and partnerships teams request through creative briefs. And product content, meaning launches and new capabilities.

This is a hands-on role. You can bring in contractors when a project calls for it, you will partner with a designer on visuals, and you will build final assets yourself from our templates rather than handing off a document. You are inheriting an early-stage foundation. There is a small case study library, a new website that needs its content simplified, an SEO program in its first months, and a set of email templates. There is no content calendar yet and no measurement baseline. Most of what exists you will rebuild.

You will be measured on influenced pipeline, meaning the pipeline our campaigns generate with your content behind them.

**Role Outcomes**
-----------------

### **First 90 days**

* A content calendar with published assets, with every planned piece tied to a named audience, a purpose, and where it will reach people.
* 4 new customer case studies interviewed, written, and approved, with the customer approval path documented so anyone can repeat it.
* An intake process agreed with sales and partnerships for creative briefs, covering how requests are prioritized and what turnaround people can expect.
* Website content simplified on the top 10 pages that matter most.
* Content measurement set up in HubSpot so influenced pipeline can be reported from month four onward.

### **First 180 days**

* Publishing on a steady cadence of 6 pieces per month without missing dates.
* 12 case studies in the library, spanning the health system types sales asks about most.
* Conference presentations and speaking submissions produced against the field marketing calendar rather than assembled the week before.
* A webinar program launched, with 4 sessions delivered.
* The SEO program showing measurable gains on 10 priority compliance topics.
* A sales and partnerships asset library organized, current, and actually being used.

### **First year**

* Success will be measured in influenced pipeline attributable to content.
* Case study production running at 2 per month.
* Hexmodal appearing as a top cited source in AI-generated answers for our priority compliance questions.
* A written voice and style guide that contractors and other teams can produce from without you rewriting it.

**Competencies**
----------------

* **Four or more years in B2B content marketing**, writing and shipping on a consistent calendar. We will consider fewer years from someone with direct healthcare or facilities experience.
* **You write well for practical, technical people

jobs.desc:
**Marketing Operations Manager**  
**Drive analytics backed marketing decisions**

You understand what works and what doesn't, what makes a campaign fly and why a campaign fails. You "get" the mechanics, metrics and analytics of marketing. Are you ready to own and lead Marketing Operations across a growing market beating SaaS solutions provider?

We are Preservica, a global leader in Active Digital Preservation, trusted by organizations to preserve their most important digital records for decades to come. From national archives and government agencies to universities and global enterprises, our customers rely on us to ensure critical information remains accessible, compliant, and defensible.

Right now we're looking for a **Marketing Operations Manager t**o build a modern, AI-powered marketing operations function from the ground up. Reporting to the VP Demand Marketing, this is a rare kind of opening: pipeline generation is our top priority as we launch a brand new digital strategy, which means marketing ops has real visibility and real budget to build something ambitious, not just keep the lights on.

**About the role**

Today, our attribution and reporting can tell you a lead came in. It can't yet show you how a cohort of MQLs actually moves through the funnel to closed revenue, and that's exactly the gap you'd own. You'll design the cohort-based reporting, the attribution model, and the AI-powered analytics practice that the board relies on to understand whether pipeline is actually working, essentially building the function you'd want to inherit, except you get to build it yourself.

You'll administer Pardot and Salesforce end to end and be the person leadership comes to when they want a real answer on what's driving pipeline. You'll also get to put Claude to work at the execution layer: turning demand gen's persona and industry targeting into shipped messaging and campaign assets at a speed manual production can't match, and finding every place in the ops stack where AI can replace repetitive work with something faster and better. If you're the kind of person who sees a basic dashboard and immediately wants to know what a great one would look like, this is that job.

**What you'll do:**

* Build and maintain dashboards and reporting on funnel performance, pipeline coverage, and channel/program ROI for leadership review

* Build and maintain attribution infrastructure (UTM frameworks, campaign-to-revenue reporting via Salesforce Campaign Influence) that holds up under scrutiny from Sales and leadership

* Push our attribution and reporting practice from basic, backward-looking numbers toward an AI-powered practice: automated anomaly detection on funnel metrics, AI-assisted narrative summaries for business reviews, and faster answers to ad hoc board and leadership questions

* Own Pardot (Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement) administration end to end: automation rules, lead scoring and grading, Engagement Studio programs, list segmentation, and data hygiene

* Maintain clean, synchronized data between Pardot and Salesforce, including lead routing, lifecycle-stage integrity, and deduplication

* Build cohort-based MQL reporting that shows how each month's (or campaign's) MQLs convert stage by stage down the funnel to pipeline and closed revenue, built for board-level review, not just an internal team dashboard

* Use Claude to produce persona- and industry-specific messaging variants and campaign assets (email sequences, landing page copy, ad copy) at volume, to specs set by demand gen and content, not as an independent campaign owner

* Identify where AI should replace manual, repetitive ops work (enrichment, routing, QA, reporting prep) and build those workflows, proactively, not just when asked

* Partner with demand gen, sales, and RevOps to diagnose funnel leaks using data, and instrument fixes rather than just report on symptoms

* Document systems, workflows, and runbooks so the stack doesn't live only in yo

Rugiet was founded on the belief that men's health has been underserved by an industry too comfortable with mediocre results. We built Ready, a patented, clinician-prescribed combination therapy that set a new standard for erectile dysfunction treatment - and then we proved the model by scaling it to tens of thousands of patients without a single retail shelf.

That success wasn't luck. It came from combining rigorous clinical science with a direct-to-patient model that removes the friction, the stigma, and the middlemen that have kept effective care out of reach for too long. Patients get better outcomes. We learn faster. The flywheel keeps spinning.

Now we're applying that same formula to a broader vision of men's health - sleep, hair loss, weight management, testosterone, and a supplements line built to the same standard as everything else we make. Each new category is an opportunity to do what we did in sexual health: find where the market is settling, build something better, and get it directly to the people who need it.

We're an Inc5000 remote-first team of builders, clinicians, marketers, and operators who move fast and take the work seriously. If you want to work on problems that matter, with people who hold themselves accountable, and at a company that's already proven its model - this is the place.

**The Role**
------------

Rugiet disrupted men's sexual health with a patented, clinical solution that outperforms everything else on the market. Now we're scaling into sleep, hair loss, weight management, and beyond - and paid social is one of the primary engines driving that growth.

We're looking for a Growth Marketing Manager who owns Paid Social end to end. You'll manage multi-million dollar monthly budgets across Meta and TikTok, partner with creative to build a high-velocity testing machine, and obsess over the numbers that actually matter: CAC, incrementality, and revenue per dollar spent. You think like a creative strategist but operate like an analyst. You don't wait to be told performance is down - you're already fixing it.

**Creative Strategy & Testing.** Partner with the Creative team to build a structured testing engine. You develop hypotheses, design the tests, read the results, and feed the loop. You know what stops a scroll for our patient personas and you know how to prove it.

**Attribution & Analytics.** Work with our Analytics team to sharpen attribution models and measure true incrementality. You should be comfortable building your own dashboards and not waiting on someone else to tell you what's happening.

**Landing Page Optimization.** Collaborate with Digital Product to make sure the post-click experience converts. The ad getting the click is half the job.

**Compliance.** All creative, targeting, and messaging must adhere to FDA, FTC, and HIPAA requirements. Healthcare experience matters here.

You treat CAC targets like a personal commitment, not a guideline. When platform changes hit, you're already engineering the workaround before leadership asks. You move fast, test faster, and document what you learn.

### **This Isn't for You If...**

You need a lot of process to get started. You report problems without bringing solutions. You think "we're waiting on the creative team" is an acceptable status update. You've never managed more than a few hundred thousand a month.

jobs.desc:
**JOB PURPOSE:**

The Hoover Institution at Stanford University is seeking an **Audience & Marketing Insights Analyst** to join its Marketing and Communications team. The role is part marketing analyst, part analytics engineer: the analyst builds the pipelines and data models that connect Hoover’s platforms, then uses that data to answer four questions:

**Who are we reaching?** Which audiences is Hoover reaching across its website, email, video, podcasts, social platforms, events, and paid media, and how effectively is it reaching the audiences most important to its mission?

**What resonates?** Which content, campaigns, fellows, topics, and formats meaningfully connect with those audiences, and why?

**What deepens relationships?** Which actions and experiences move people from a single encounter with Hoover to repeat engagement, subscriptions, event attendance, and a lasting, direct relationship with the Institution?

**What should we do differently?** How should those insights change Hoover’s decisions about content, distribution, audience acquisition, and marketing investment?

The analyst will move beyond reporting what happened to explain why it happened, what it means, and what Hoover should do next. Success in this role is measured not by the volume of analysis produced, but by the quality of the decisions it informs.

The ideal candidate pairs genuine marketing judgment (about how audiences discover ideas, how content and campaigns are planned and distributed, and how marketing teams make decisions) with the hands-on technical skills to build and use the data foundation behind that judgment: connecting Hoover’s platforms through APIs and ELT pipelines, modeling data in BigQuery and Dataform, interpreting GA4 and HubSpot data correctly, and applying the right statistical tests.

This position reports to the Senior Manager, Digital Growth Strategy and works cross-functionally across Hoover’s Marketing and Communications organization.

**CORE DUTIES**

**Data Infrastructure & Pipelines**

Build and maintain automated ELT pipelines that bring data from HubSpot, GA4, social, video, podcast, paid media, and event platforms into BigQuery through APIs and native integrations, replacing manual exports.

Organize marketing and audience data in BigQuery using a medallion architecture, developing Dataform transformations that turn raw and semi-structured data (such as the GA4 event export and JSON API responses) into cleaned, reporting-ready tables.

Document data models, shared identifiers, transformation rules, and metric definitions in a data dictionary so that marketing, audience, CRM, web, and content data connect reliably.

Monitor pipelines and data freshness so that failures are caught before they affect reporting, and manage code in Git and GitHub so the work stays reproducible, maintainable, and transferable to others.

Handle audience and contact data, credentials, and system access responsibly and in accordance with Stanford privacy and information security policies and applicable regulations.

**Measurement & Tracking**

Ensure campaigns, content, and audience initiatives launch with appropriate tracking, tagging, and measurement plans, and maintain consistent campaign naming and UTM conventions.

Define GA4 event and data layer specifications in partnership with web developers, and QA tracking implementations using tools such as Google Tag Manager preview mode and GA4 DebugView.

Resolve tracking and data-quality issues with Hoover’s web team and external partners, and investigate discrepancies between GA4, HubSpot, and platform-reported figures before conclusions are presented to stakeholders.

**Audience Intelligence: Reach, Resonance & Relationships**

Characterize who Hoover is reaching (for example, by geography, profession, content interests, and relationship with Hoover) and how effectively it reaches its priority audiences, using CRM, web, platform, event, and survey data.

jobs.title: Email Marketing Specialist
jobs.desc:
**Opportunity Summary:**

SP6 is seeking an Email Marketing Specialist to own our B2B email program from strategy to results. You will be the voice of SP6 in the inbox, turning email into a reliable engine for pipeline and customer engagement.

This role is for a hands-on email marketer who is ready to take ownership: planning campaigns, building automated nurture programs, managing our lists and deliverability, and proving impact with data. You will work directly with leadership and sales, and you will help shape how we reach the security, risk, compliance, and IT leaders responsible for how their organizations use AI.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

**Strategy and planning**

* Take ownership of the email marketing function, partnering with leadership to set goals tied to demand generation and pipeline.
* Build and maintain the email marketing calendar, aligning sends with product launches, events, webinars, and sales priorities.
* Develop segmentation and cadence strategies for prospects, customers, and partners.

**Campaign execution**

* Plan, build, and send campaigns to client and prospect audiences, including newsletters, promotional sends, event invitations, and product announcements.
* Coordinate with content creators across the company, and project manage the flow of content into the email program.
* Write and edit email copy and subject lines that speak to security, risk, and compliance leaders, turning complex AI governance and security topics into clear, practical messages.
* Run QA on every send, including content, links, PDFs, rendering across devices, and personalization fields.

**Automation and nurture**

* Design, build, and optimize automated workflows, including lead nurture tracks, onboarding sequences, and re-engagement campaigns.
* Work with sales to align email touches with the sales process and lead handoff.

**Lists, data, and deliverability**

* Build targeted prospect lists using Salesforce and ZoomInfo, and manage list growth strategies.
* Manage the contact database, including segmentation, data hygiene, suppression, and unsubscribes.
* Protect sender reputation and inbox placement by monitoring bounces, spam complaints, and authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC).

**Testing, reporting, and optimization**

* Run A/B tests on subject lines, content, calls to action, and send times, and apply the results.
* Own weekly reporting on campaign KPIs, including open, click, conversion, and unsubscribe rates, against best practices and historical performance.
* Report monthly and quarterly on email's contribution to leads, pipeline, and revenue.
* Recommend improvements to email systems, processes, and tools to drive demand generation.

**Other**

* Support other tasks needed for the team's success.

  
**Requirements**

**Required Experience:**

* 2+ years of hands-on email marketing experience.
* Proven experience in email campaign creation and execution for technical or regulated B2B buyers, such as security, risk, compliance, and IT leaders.
* Experience running email campaigns from planning through execution and reporting, and a desire to own the full program.
* Ability to segment audiences and tailor messaging across SP6's markets: AI governance, risk, and compliance; AI security; AI system resiliency; security operations (SIEM); and cyber risk and compliance.
* Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a similar marketing automation platform, such as Marketo or Pardot.
* Experience with automation, workflows, segmentation, and nurture strategy.
* Working knowledge of deliverability, list management, and email compliance.
* Comfort with data: you track KPIs, run tests, and turn results into recommendations.
* Clear, concise writing and strong attention to detail.

**Experience and knowledge with any of the following software products is a plus:**

* Splunk

jobs.desc:
**Job Description:**

***This is a remote/hybrid opportunity based in the US***

The Customer Lifecycle Marketing (CLM) Practice Lead, reporting to the President, Data-Driven Marketing, serves as the commercial owner and market-facing leader of Merkle's CLM practice. This leader operates as a mini-P&L owner across four interconnected capability areas: lifecycle marketing and email/CRM platform execution, loyalty strategy and technology, promotions and gamified experiences, and the first-party data and identity infrastructure that connects them. The role sits at the intersection of go-to-market strategy, offer development, and senior client leadership, and forms one leg of the practice's leadership team.

This is a commercial leadership role, not a delivery management role. It requires the credibility to engage CMOs and VP-level buyers across the full spectrum, from loyalty program economics to first-party data strategy to paid media activation. Success is measured through practice revenue and pipeline growth, win rate, cross-practice attach, and the strength of Merkle's market position in loyalty, lifecycle marketing, and data-driven CRM.

**Description & Responsibilities:**

**Practice Growth & Commercial Ownership**

* Own commercial performance of the CLM practice, including revenue, pipeline, forecast accuracy, and margin contribution across all four capability pillars
* Develop and maintain the annual CLM growth plan, aligned to organizational go-to-market priorities and key vertical and platform opportunities
* Approve commercial scope, pricing, and deal economics on CLM-led pursuits, engaging senior sales leadership on larger or cross-practice opportunities

**Offer Development & Market Positioning**

* Own the CLM offer portfolio across lifecycle marketing, loyalty, promotions, and first-party data/identity, in partnership with strategy and solutions teams
* Articulate Merkle's integrated CLM story to the market: how loyalty strategy, promotions design, journey orchestration, and paid media activation combine into a customer equity growth system
* Maintain external market positioning through analyst relationships, industry events, and published thought leadership on the convergence of loyalty, promotions, and paid media
* Partner with strategy teams to translate platform partner developments into updated offer packages, and represent the practice in partner co-sell conversations

**Pursuit Leadership & Commercial Execution**

* Lead the CLM-specific pursuit motion across loyalty RFPs, lifecycle marketing retainers, promotions engagements, and first-party data strategy mandates
* Build pursuit teams that draw on the full CLM capability stack to ensure proposals reflect Merkle's integrated breadth
* Coordinate with demand generation and sales teams on origination specific to CLM buyer personas (e.g., VP CRM, VP Loyalty, VP Marketing Technology, Chief Digital Officer)
* Represent the practice at partner events, client advisory boards, and industry conferences as a named commercial voice on loyalty, lifecycle marketing, and data-driven CRM

**Senior Client Engagement & Cross-Practice Orchestration**

* Maintain executive-level relationships with the CLM practice's primary buying personas across a portfolio of key accounts
* Serve as executive sponsor on flagship CLM accounts, supporting retention, expansion, and reference development
* Bring the CLM practice into integrated pursuits where loyalty, promotions, or first-party data activation is the commercial entry point for broader engagements
* Champion integrated storytelling that connects loyalty program performance to paid media efficiency and customer lifetime value

**Talent & Commercial Bench Development**

* Identify and develop commercial talent within the CLM practice across all four capability pillars
* Build the next generation of pursuit-capable solutions leads with fluency in loyalty economics, promotions architecture, and first-party data strategy

jobs.desc:
**About the opportunity**

We are a criminal defense firm in Fort Worth that handles serious state and federal cases for people facing the worst point of their lives. Our growth has always depended on being findable at the moment someone needs a lawyer, and until now we have run that function through an outside agency.

This is a new position, and the person who takes it owns the firm's entire digital presence: the website, analytics, third-party profiles, and the growing share of prospective clients who now find lawyers by asking an AI instead of typing into Google.

This is a technical role. If you are strongest at brand storytelling and campaign concepting, this is not the seat for you. If you are the person who actually knows why a page is not indexing and can tie a signed case back to the phone call that produced it, keep reading.

**What you'll do**

* **Own the website.** Technical SEO, site health, page speed, structure, on-page optimization, and ongoing maintenance. You will also lead a homepage redesign in your first year.
* **Own the numbers.** Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and call tracking. Build the attribution picture that connects traffic to leads, leads to consultations, and consultations to signed cases, then make recommendations accordingly.
* **Own our off-site presence.** Directory and credential profiles, the state bar, and others. Each one gets treated as a small website with its own bios, practice areas, and links to be maintained and optimized.
* **Improve our visibility in AI search.** ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google's AI results increasingly decide who gets called. We currently have no deliberate strategy here. Building one is a core part of this job, not a side project.
* **Run content production.** Blog and practice-area pages on a consistent cadence, plus steady social posting across LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and Google Business Profile. You will use AI tools to move faster; you will also be the one who catches when the output is wrong, generic, or off-brand.
* **Manage what stays outsourced.** Hosting, design help, video production, and any remaining vendor scopes. You hold them to deliverables and to a budget.
* **Report monthly.** A standing review with firm leadership covering rankings, traffic, lead volume and quality, AI citations, and cost per signed case.

**What we're looking for**

* **Real technical SEO experience.** Three or more years where SEO was your actual job, not one line in a marketing coordinator role. You can audit a site, diagnose an indexing problem, and fix it yourself.
* **Hands-on site management.** You familiar enough with HTML and CSS to make changes without waiting on a developer, and have the ability to troubleshoot a Wordpress site.
* **Analytics fluency.** GA4 and Search Console are daily tools. You can build a report that answers a business question rather than one that just displays data.
* **Independent judgment.** This is a department of one. Nobody here will check your work for technical accuracy, which means you have to be the kind of person who checks it themselves.
* **Discretion.** You will work around privileged information constantly. Our clients' matters are not marketing material, and knowing the difference is non-negotiable.
* **Directness.** When something is not working, we want to hear it in the first month, not the sixth.

**Nice to have**

* Experience marketing for a law firm or another professional services business
* Short-form video — shooting and cutting reels-quality clips for social; we do not need broadcast production
* Paid search or paid social management
* Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization at multi-location scale
* Familiarity with legal directory ecosystems and attorney credentialing
* Comfort building small automations to reduce manual reporting work

**Compensation and benefits**

* Base salary of $90,000
* Health insurance after 90 days, with the employee premium covered at 100%
* 401(k) wit

We're hiring a Marketing Manager to shape Takt's market presence and make sure supply chain leaders understand who we are, what we offer, and why it matters to their operations. You'll report to Alex Pankhurst, our acting Chief Revenue Officer, and work closely with Sales, Product, and Takt's founders.

You will plan and run the programs that build awareness and generate pipeline, from multi-touch campaigns aimed at warehouse and logistics leaders, to trade shows and customer events, to the day-to-day voice of Takt on LinkedIn and beyond. The right person is just as happy mapping out a quarterly campaign plan as writing the LinkedIn post that kicks it off. You'd enjoy locking in a booth at a major supply chain show, and you'd take pride in getting the follow-up emails out the next morning.

Ownership is the core of this job. You'll own the results of the programs you run, not just the tasks. You'll decide which shows we attend, which agencies and freelancers we bring in, and what to change in our tools. In return, we expect you to follow through without being chased and to tell us plainly what worked and what didn't.

You won't start from zero: paid search and webinars are already running, and we have customer results worth telling. In your first year, events and campaigns come first. Social, content, and brand matter too, and you'll build them up alongside.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* Plan, launch, and run integrated campaigns (email, paid, social, content, and outbound support) targeting operations, supply chain, and warehouse leaders at retailers, e-commerce brands, and 3PLs.

jobs.desc:
**Job title:** Freelance Creatives: Photo, Video, Design, Copy & Web (Cleveland, OH)  
**Job type:** Contract / project-based

**About Savori Media**  
Savori Media is a Cleveland-based growth marketing agency. We help local and regional businesses, from home services and wellness to restaurants and real estate, get found, get leads, and grow. We're a small, founder-led team, and we're building a bench of reliable freelancers to produce the work.

**Who we're looking for**  
Independent creatives and specialists for one-time and small projects. You don't need to do everything. Tell us what you're great at:

* Photographers (hourly, half-day, and full-day shoots)
* Videographers and video editors (promos, reels, short-form)
* Copywriters (ad copy, website copy, blog and SEO/GEO articles, email/SMS, social captions)
* Web designers and builders (landing pages, small websites)
* SEO/GEO specialists (audits, schema setup, Google Business Profile setup)
* Graphic and brand designers (flyers, social posts, logos, menus, signage)
* Billboard and out-of-home designers (static and digital)
* Merch and product designers (graphics and mockups)

**How the work works**

* Every job comes with a brief, a clear scope, a set turnaround, and a flat rate from our rate card. No bidding and no haggling.
* One round of revisions is included in every package.
* You're paid within 14 days of approved delivery.
* Work is project-based. Jobs come in as clients sign, and we can't guarantee a set amount of work.

**Pay**  
Flat per-project rates, roughly $15 to $750 depending on the service. A few examples: single flyer or post, $25. Short promo reel, $100. Blog or GEO article, $60. Landing page, $200. Mini photo shoot, $75. We send the full rate card for your services before your first job.

**What you'll need**

* A portfolio link that shows the work you want to do for us
* Your own equipment and software
* Reliability: you hit deadlines and reply quickly
* Comfort working from a brief and to a spec
* Willingness to sign our Freelancer Rate Card & Work Agreement before your first job

**Good to know**

* This is independent contractor work. You handle your own taxes, insurance, and equipment.
* Finished work belongs to Savori or our client once you're paid, and client information stays confidential. You can show the work in your portfolio with our written permission.
* Shoots are on-site in the Cleveland area. Digital work can be done remotely.

Pay: $100.00 - $1,000.00 per month

Work Location: On the road

Summary

5. Team Leadership & Development

* Build and mentor a high-performing marketing team, fostering growth, accountability, and excellence both internally and externally..
* Develop and conduct training programs to strengthen marketing capabilities and ensure team alignment with organizational goals.

6. Other Responsibilities

* Perform other duties as assigned.

KPI’s & Metrics

Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) Generated

* Target: 8 MQLs per day
* Metric: Track daily lead generation and pipeline contribution; monitor lead quality and conversion potential.

Advertising Return on Ad Spend (RoAS)

* Target: Minimum 3:1

Website Organic Traffic Growth

Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)

* Target: Optimize CAC while maintaining lead quality

Email Marketing Performance

* Targets: Open Rate ≥ 22%, Click-Through Rate (CTR) ≥ 4%
* Metric: Measure engagement through email campaigns; analyze subject lines, content, and send timing to improve results.

Social Media Engagement Growth

* Target: Positive YoY growth % (specific % can be defined per quarter)
* Metric: Track likes, shares, comments, and overall follower engagement; optimize social content strategy for maximum reach and interaction.

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Public Relations, Communicati

------------

mhp.si is a digital marketing agency in Little Rock, Arkansas, serving more than 150 clients across a variety of locations and industries. The Marketing Analyst role joins our Marketing Technology team and supports their full range of work: SEO, AI search visibility, content strategy, marketing automation, CRM management, email marketing, analytics setup and tracking, and automated client reporting.

Noteable is a behavioral health EHR built to make the work behind care feel more manageable. We bring clinical documentation, scheduling, billing, and essential practice operations together in one platform, so ABA and community-based mental health providers can spend less time wrestling with disconnected systems and more time focused on the people they serve.

We're hiring a Paid Media Specialist to turn Noteable's go-to-market strategy into well-run, measurable paid acquisition campaigns. You'll work closely with our Director of Sales and Marketing, who leads Noteable's GTM strategy, to execute across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Reddit, retargeting platforms, and other approved channels as our approach evolves.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes getting close to the work: building campaigns, writing and testing ad copy, managing audiences and retargeting, monitoring performance, and following the data until the story makes sense. You will not be expected to invent our strategy in a vacuum or build the entire paid media function alone. GTM leadership will set priorities, positioning, budget parameters, and performance goals; you will bring disciplined execution, reliable measurement, and practical recommendations.

RapidAir is a leading designer and manufacturer of branded compressed air solutions—including piping, fittings, filtration, and accessories—serving transportation, manufacturing, industrial, energy, agricultural, and consumer markets.

BCII is the production company behind *Overhaulin'*, the show that put Chip Foose in America's living rooms and created the automotive makeover genre. * Launch and manage Amazon and other marketplace channels as the business expands, protecting pricing, listings, and brand integrity.

**Schedule:** Full-Time

This role blends content creation, social media strategy, and community engagement. One day you may be building a social campaign or managing paid ads, and the next you may be helping lead a grand opening or community event. If you enjoy variety, collaboration, and fast-paced environments where no two days look exactly the same, this could be a great fit.

* 70% social media marketing
* 30% field marketing and events

Social Media Marketing

* Monitor engagement, comments, messages, and online reviews across platforms
* Support real-time clinic communications and marketing initiatives as needed

Field Marketing & Events
  
  

* Help lead grand openings, school partnerships, sponsorships, and community events
* Travel throughout the Southeast to support local marketing efforts and event activations
* Coordinate event logistics, signage, swag, and marketing materials
* Capture photo and video content at events for social media and future campaigns
* Represent both brands in a professional, energetic, and community-focused way

What We’re Looking For...
  
  
Required
  
  

* 2+ years of experience in social media, digital marketing, or related marketing roles
* Experience managing social media for a business or brand
* Strong writing and communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
* Organized, dependable, and detail-oriented
* Self-starter who can execute independently while collaborating with a team
* Willingness to travel and work occasional nights/weekends during peak event seasons

Preferred
  
  

* Experience with Meta Ads Manager or paid social advertising
* Basic Canva or graphic editing experience
* Experience in healthcare, retail, hospitality, or multi-location businesses
* Familiarity with online reputation management and customer engagement

About You
  
  

* You’re creative, proactive, and resourceful
* You thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy wearing multiple hats
* You’re comfortable balancing strategy with hands-on execution
* You genuinely enjoy building community connections and creating engaging content
* You care about doing great work and being part of a collaborative team

If you're the kind of person who can't scroll through a brand's social feed without immediately thinking about what you'd do differently, you'll probably like this role. This person will own organic social strategy and execution across a diverse portfolio of brands: developing content concepts, writing copy, managing communities, analyzing performance, spotting opportunities, and continually deciding what we should do next.

* Develop content concepts that connect each brand's goals, audience, voice, platform, and larger marketing strategy.
