**Role overview**

We are hiring a Social Media Manager to plan, create and run social media marketing for five golf properties across Central Florida. You will own the strategy and the day-to-day: monthly content shoots, community engagement, paid social campaigns and on-site event coverage. You will report directly to the Director of Marketing and help shape overall brand strategy across the portfolio.

This is a hands-on, field-based role. You will spend regular time at each property capturing content, working alongside our videographer and editors, and partnering with on-site serving staff to turn everyday moments on the course, range and patio into content that drives tee times, range visits, event bookings and food and beverage sales.

**Golf Properties:**

**ZenWoods Golf Club**

* Inverness, FL
* 9 Hole Course
* High Tech Driving Range

**ZenSprings Golf Club**

* Dunnellon, FL
* 9 Hole Course
* High Tech Driving Range (coming soon)

**ZenSwings Golf Club**

* Homosassa, FL
* High Tech Driving Range

**ZenOaks Golf Club**

* Ridge Manor, FL
* 18 Hole Course
* 8 Hole Pitch & Putt
* High Tech Driving Range

**The Club at Venetian Bay**

* New Smyrna Beach, FL
* 18 Hole Course
* High Tech Driving Range

Each property has its own audience, offerings and brand voice. You will manage separate accounts and content calendars for each while keeping a consistent standard of quality across the portfolio.

**Key responsibilitiesCampaign strategy and execution**

* Build and run integrated social campaigns for each property: seasonal promotions, memberships, leagues, tournaments, range nights, food and beverage specials and events.
* Maintain a monthly content calendar per property, aligned with marketing, sales and operations priorities.
* Write captions, hooks and calls to action that fit each property's brand voice.
* Keep current on platform trends, formats and features (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and others) and apply them quickly.

**Monthly content shoots**

* Plan and lead a monthly content shoot at each property, including shot lists, schedules, talent and logistics.
* Direct the videographer and coordinate with on-site managers so shoots run smoothly around guests and operations.
* Capture supplemental photo and short-form video yourself between scheduled shoots.

**Videographer and editor collaboration**

* Brief the videographer and editors on campaign goals, concepts and deliverables.
* Review edits, give clear feedback and manage turnaround so content goes live on schedule.
* Organize and maintain a shared content library tagged by property, season and content type.

**On-site events**

* Cover selected on-site events (tournaments, outings, live music, DJ nights, holiday events, private parties) to capture real-time and recap content.
* Post live stories and in-the-moment content during events when appropriate.

**On-site staff content partnership**

* Work with serving staff, bartenders and front-of-house teams to capture food, drink and guest-experience content.
* Coach staff on simple, on-brand content capture and recruit willing team members for on-camera features.
* Create a simple process for staff to share photos and clips from shifts and events.

**Community engagement**

* Respond to comments, messages and reviews across all accounts in a timely, on-brand way.
* Escalate guest service issues to the right property manager.
* Engage with local businesses, golf communities, influencers and partners to grow reach.

**Paid social**

* Plan, launch and optimize paid social campaigns (Meta Ads Manager and other platforms as needed).
* Manage the paid social budget across properties, tracking spend, pacing and return.
* Build audiences, test creative and adjust targeting to hit booking and sales goals.

**Reporting**

* Track performance by property: reach, engagement, follower growth, ad results and bookings driven.
* Deliver a monthly performance report with insights and recommendations for the next month.

Headquartered in Bethesda, MD, we combine institutional-grade investment expertise with a quantitative process that is Built to Conquer Risk**®.**

The **Digital Marketing Strategist (Paid Media)** is a performance-driven digital marketing professional responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing pay-per-click (PPC) and paid media campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, Google Ads, and other digital advertising platforms. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on campaign management to drive measurable business outcomes through audience targeting, conversion optimization, and data-driven decision-making.

Working closely with marketing, sales, and leadership teams, this individual will build and manage full-funnel digital advertising campaigns that generate awareness, nurture prospects, and drive qualified leads for Potomac's growing business. jobs.title: Demand Generation Manager
jobs.desc:
*The AI Operating System for Private Capital.*

**Capsa**

Private capital funds have to find potential investments, research and analyse them thoroughly, monitor them over time, drive improvements, and decide when to buy and sell. They've got to see through the marketing. They've got to outbid the competition. And they've got to learn from every deal they do. Historically, these processes have run on people, we are building the AI Operating System that will run them in the future.

We're focused, ambitious, and obsessed with building a category-defining company. In the last 12 months we've grown ARR 15x, achieved product–market fit with leading multi-billion-dollar PE firms, and expanded across the US, UK, and Europe. Now we're doubling down: we've raised a large Series A from top-tier VC investors to scale the team. We're hiring hyper-talented people who want to work at the forefront of AI and revolutionise an industry.

**At a glance**

**Role:** Demand Generation Manager

**Location:** New York (In-office, Monday–Friday. Right to work in the US required)

**Team:** Marketing

**Experience Required:** Several years in B2B marketing, including in demand generation or growth marketing at a high-growth B2B SaaS or fintech startup. Hands-on HubSpot ownership required.

**The role**

Full-stack demand generation: plan, build, ship, and own the pipeline it creates.

You'll turn Capsa's story into pipeline across paid, owned, social, and in-person channels, putting us in front of the PE investors who should be buying and giving them a reason to take the meeting. As one of the first marketing hires, you'll work directly with the CEO and CRO on positioning and narrative, alongside Sales and a lean, senior marketing team.

There's no playbook to inherit. You'll build the systems, the cadence, and the channel mix from the ground up, then scale what works as the team and budget grow.

**The opportunity**

* Own pipeline. Set sourced and influenced pipeline targets with leadership, build the plan to hit them, and report on ICP demos and stage conversion weekly.
* Run HubSpot as the engine. Campaigns, workflows, lead scoring, attribution, nurture, and reporting, kept clean, connected to Sales, and trusted by the business.
* Make paid media accountable. LinkedIn, Google, Meta, and retargeting. Audience, creative, budget, and optimisation, with every dollar measured against pipeline, not clicks.
* Ship integrated campaigns. Launches, product moments, and always-on programmes taken from brief to live to results across email, landing pages, paid, social, and sales enablement.
* Choose where we show up. Industry conferences, executive dinners, and private gatherings with PE investors in NYC, London, and beyond. Run end to end, so that every event turns into conversations.
* Own capsa.ai content, conversion, SEO and AEO, page builds, and experimentation for our best salesperson.
* Build a social presence PE professionals follow. Company and founder channels, LinkedIn first.
* Design and write in-house. Ads, landing pages, event assets, and social creative in Figma, with copy that's clear, specific, and written for a sophisticated finance audience.
* Manage agencies and tooling. Paid media, SEO, and event partners, plus a stack that lets a small team move like a big one.

**Track record**

* Several years in B2B marketing. Including in demand generation at a high-growth B2B SaaS or fintech startup. Selling to financial services, private equity, or other sophisticated enterprise buyers is a strong plus.
* A HubSpot power user. You've owned the marketing side yourself: workflows, lead scoring, attribution, and dashboards leadership actually uses.
* Full-funnel, multi-channel experience. Paid, email, social, web, events, field, and sponsorships. You know which to lean on, and when.
* Pipeline accountability. You've owned a pipeline number and can show how your programmes moved it.
* Website and design chops. You've owned a company website in a CMS

**Salary:** $70,000 to $85,000 base

**About TFC Tuition**

For over 55 years, TFC Tuition has been making education more accessible. We partner with colleges, universities, and career schools nationwide to offer flexible, student-focused institutional loan and payment plan solutions that help students afford higher education. We are independently owned with a focus on service over optics. That means our clients interact with real people, including our leadership, and it means we make decisions based on long-term relationships and student outcomes rather than quarterly earnings.

**Position Overview**

At TFC, marketing isn't just about campaigns. It's about helping more students access the education they deserve. Our solutions are flexible and feature-rich, but what wins and keeps institutions is the service behind them. Marketing here has to carry both.

You will lead implementation across email, social, brand, collateral, events, and reporting. We have a rebranding initiative soft-launched and a real opportunity to expand from our stronghold in career education into traditional higher education. Whoever takes this role will shape how that goes.

You won't do it alone. Our business development, client success, and leadership teams are genuinely engaged in marketing and will be collaborators. We need someone who can take that input, make the right call, and manage the work.

There is a direct line from this work to whether students can afford to stay enrolled.

**Key Responsibilities**

We hire smart, capable people and find the right role for them to grow. You don't need experience with everything listed here.

**Digital Marketing and Campaign Execution**

* Design, execute, and optimize email campaigns in Zoho Marketing Automation, targeting bursars, financial aid, student financial services, owners, enrollment, and other stakeholders
* Manage social campaigns across LinkedIn, where our institutional audience lives, plus Facebook and other relevant platforms
* Own the content calendar across email and social
* Draft and edit marketing copy for campaigns, newsletters, and communications
* Create visual materials including graphics, infographics, presentations, and promotional collateral

**Brand Strategy and Positioning**

* Lead ongoing implementation of our rebranding initiative, collaborating with business development, client success, and leadership on direction while owning execution
* Maintain brand consistency across every channel
* Conduct competitive analysis and market research to identify positioning opportunities

**Sales Enablement and Collaboration**

* Create marketing materials that support business development across both our New York and California teams, aligned with sales objectives to drive qualified inbound leads

**Event Marketing and Thought Leadership**

* Coordinate trade show presence, conference participation, webinars, and presentations
* Draft press releases, company announcements, and thought leadership content
* Identify speaking opportunities and awards submissions

**Analytics and Market Intelligence**

* Establish and monitor KPIs across all marketing channels
* Prepare performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations

**What You Need**

* 3 to 5 years of B2B marketing experience
* Hands-on ownership of email campaigns from build through reporting. Zoho Marketing Automation preferred, but HubSpot, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Pardot, Constant Contact, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud all transfer
* Writing that holds up with a professional audience. You will be writing to college administrators, not consumers
* Design skills in Canva, InDesign, PowerPoint, or similar. You should be able to turn a rough idea into finished collateral on your own, whether that’s a one-pager

jobs.title: Social Media Manager – Part-time, Miami (Instagram & TikTok)
jobs.desc:
Social Media Manager – Part-time, Miami (mostly remote) · First hire at a design studio with big plans

About M5

M5 Studio Miami is a young interior design & build studio with one clear goal: to become the #1 builder of luxury private homes in the United States, starting right here in Miami. We design and renovate condos and villas, and our signature is hand-applied Venetian plaster and Marmorino: 27 finishes made by our master, not picked from a catalog. Our Miami showroom opens in November.

What makes us different: we run the studio on an AI-powered operating system we built ourselves. Every lead, project, estimate and piece of content lives in one place. For you that means no chaos: a brand guide, a visual style, a content calendar, captions in English and Spanish, and a library of 130+ real photos and 40+ raw clips, ready on day one.

Our values: quality, speed, style, technology, leadership by results. We are small and early, which is exactly why the person who builds our social media from post #1 gets to own it as we grow.

The role

Part-time, about 15 hours a week, flexible. Mostly remote: you work from wherever you like in Miami, plus 1–2 on-site shoots a month (job sites and our showroom) once it opens in November. You must live in Miami-Dade or Broward County.

What you'll do

* Run Instagram and TikTok: 3 posts and 3 reels a week, stories on weekdays

* Cross-post to Facebook, YouTube Shorts and Pinterest

* Edit reels yourself (CapCut or any editor) from our raw clips; design covers and carousels in our style

* Shoot on site with your phone: real walls, real textures, real process

* Reply to comments and DMs; pass every inquiry to the team within 15 minutes

* 30-minute weekly call; short monthly report (reach, saves, inquiries)

Who we're looking for

* You have run Instagram and TikTok for a design, interiors, architecture, real estate, furniture or lifestyle brand, and you can show it

* You have taste: you know what a premium, magazine-style feed looks like and can tell why one reel works and another doesn't

* You edit reels yourself and shoot well on a phone

* You write clean English; Spanish is a strong plus in Miami

* You keep a schedule without reminders

* You live in Miami-Dade or Broward and are authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship (W-2 employee role)

Pay and growth

* $1,400/month base for about 15 hours a week (roughly $21.50/hour), W-2, flexible schedule

* Up to $300/month performance bonus (publishing plan + engagement and inquiries), up to $1,700/month total

* The role grows to full-time and Head of Social as the studio grows; pay follows results

* You work directly with the founders; decisions take a day, not a quarter

How to apply (we only review applications with work samples)

1. Links to 1–3 accounts you ran and what exactly you did there

2. One reel you edited yourself

3. Where in Miami you're based and your weekly availability

4. Your Spanish level

Shortlisted candidates get a paid test ($75, about 3 hours): 3 grid tiles, 1 reel with a cover, 1 caption in English and Spanish, all from our materials. Then a 30-minute call with the founders and a coffee in Miami.

M5 Studio Miami LLC is an equal opportunity employer.

Pay: $1,400.00 - $1,700.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* Paste links to 1–3 Instagram/TikTok accounts you ran and describe what exactly you did there (strategy, content, editing). Applications without links will not be reviewed.
* Paste a link to one reel you edited yourself (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or Drive).
* Which city or neighborhood in Miami-Dade or Broward County do you live in? What is your weekly availability, and what is your Spanish level (none / basic / conversational / fluent)?
* What is your current U.S. work authorization? Please specify: U.S. citizen / permanent resident (green card) / EAD (please state the basis and expiry date) / other. This is a W-2 role; we cannot sponsor visas.

**About impact.com**  
impact.com is the world's leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products - Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral) - unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands - including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L'Oréal, and Fanatics - rely on impact.com to power more than 350,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results.

**Your Role at impact.com:**

Impact.com powers the partnership economy, helping brands and partners grow revenue through a modern SaaS platform used by thousands of companies globally. We're investing heavily in our growth, and this role sits at the centre of how data powers our go-to-market strategy and sales enablement. We're looking for an Analytics Manager to scale our marketing function. This is a senior individual contributor role - we need someone who's comfortable owning a domain of the marketing analytics portfolio with light oversight.

As **Marketing** Analytics Manager, you'll own the quality, consistency, and strategic impact of the core reporting used by our GTM teams to shape and prioritize multimillion dollar investment decisions. You'll work on a modern cloud stack (BigQuery, dbt, Looker) with strong support from Marketing and Sales teams - who will be your chief internal customers, and Analytics Engineering, who own the data platform and semantic layer you work with and on.

**What You'll Do:**

* Own the process for the weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews that marketing and sales leaders use to track campaign performance and business trends — and improve them over time so they drive decisions rather than descriptions.
* Translate vague business questions ("why is pipeline soft in EMEA?") into workable analyses, sell a solution, and manage the delivery process efficiently.
* + Partner with internal customers and engineers to move recurring manual reporting into useful tools that drive decisions which save time and money.
  + Work directly with stakeholders across marketing, sales, finance, product, and customer success to scope what they actually need and design a plan to get them that information efficiently and with the right level of accuracy.
* Contribute to data collection and modeling conversations where marketing's needs intersect with the broader company data model.

**What You Bring:**

* 5+ years of business analytics experience in a software or information business.
* A strong understanding of SQL and working proficiency with Python — enough to do your own analysis end-to-end without needing outside help.
* A track record of designing dashboards and reports that people use to actually make decisions, and a sense of taste on what makes the difference between decisive reporting and vague reporting.
* Ability to explain an analysis or technical concept to colleagues in a way that drives action.
* Comfortable owning a workstream end-to-end with light oversight: you'll get direction on weekly priorities and outcomes, but will be trusted to set your own week and say no to the right things.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with attribution modeling — multi-touch, time decay, incrementality
* Experience with lead scoring
* Experience with integration of sales and marketing data and a full-funnel perspective
* Experience with dbt, databricks, Looker, or another data management tool
* Experience in partnership marketing, digital marketing, or performance marketing

jobs.desc:
**DIGITAL MARKETING MANAGER**

The Luminos Fund, an international nonprofit bringing education opportunities to the world's most vulnerable children, seeks a Digital Marketing Manager to help more people discover, engage with, and support our education mission. This is an opportunity for an ambitious, creative, data-informed marketer to grow Luminos' reach among prospective donors and influencers, and convert that interest into lasting, quantifiable engagement and support.

The Digital Marketing Manager will manage Luminos' social media channels, digital audience growth, and outreach for major fundraising and awareness campaigns. Working closely with colleagues in Development and Communications, the manager will expand Luminos' online reach by bringing Luminos stories and evidence to new audiences, engage and steward our existing online champions, and enhance the online experience for Luminos supporters. A central priority will be to expand Luminos' online individual giving program, with success measured against growth in online contributors. This role will own digital marketing planning, execution, and reporting across channels, working in tight alignment with Luminos' broader messaging and editorial priorities.

This new full-time role will report to the Senior Director of Communications within the Development & Communications team. We prefer candidates based in Boston or London, for overlap with the team, but will consider exceptional candidates based remotely within time zones from U.S. Eastern Time and GMT. Occasional travel may be required. We are looking to fill this position as soon as possible.

**About The Luminos Fund**

The Luminos Fund (www.luminosfund.org (http://www.luminosfund.org/)) provides transformative education programs to thousands of vulnerable children each year, helping them to catch up to grade level and prepare for lifelong learning. Working in partnership with community-based organizations in sub-Saharan Africa and the Middle East, Luminos is scaling up its accelerated learning program through the Luminos Method (www.luminosmethod.org) (http://www.luminosmethod.org/) — an evidence-based approach that helps children catch up fast and discover the joy of learning.

Luminos is supported by a range of funding partners, including Cartier Philanthropy for People and Nature, the Gates Foundation, UBS Optimus Foundation, and UNICEF. Luminos has been recognized for its achievements globally, receiving the Klaus J. Jacobs Best Practice Prize, the Library of Congress International Literacy Award, the Lipman Family Prize, the WISE Award, and the HundrED Global Innovation Award.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
The Performance Marketing Manager owns paid customer acquisition across our consumer lending, credit card, and tax filing products. This is a hands-on role responsible for building, operating, and scaling paid digital acquisition campaigns, and for connecting media investment to downstream outcomes: funded loans, loan value, and credit performance. The ideal candidate is in ad platforms daily, fluent in the unit economics of lending, and comfortable partnering with Analytics, Compliance, Legal, and Operations to launch programs that are both high-performing and defensible.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Paid Media Strategy and Execution**

* Own the strategy, build, daily management, and scaling of Google Ads and Microsoft Ads search campaigns with monthly budgets of $50,000 to $100,000, including keyword architecture, match type strategy, negative keywords, and Quality Score optimization for high-CPC loan queries.
* Operate programmatic demand-side platforms (StackAdapt or comparable) directly, including native, display, and connected TV campaign setup, audience construction, supply and inventory controls, and brand safety settings.
* Manage paid social, lead aggregator, and affiliate partners, including source-level pricing, quality monitoring, and compliance review of partner creative and consent language.
* Develop bidding strategy: value-based bidding, target ROAS, and target CPA mapped to loan value and credit performance.
* Maintain a continuous test-and-learn roadmap across audiences, bidding, creative, and placements.
* Own annual and quarterly budget planning, pacing, and forecasting; reallocate spend by channel, product, and geography based on marginal return, aligning media weight with branch footprint and scaling into peak tax filing season.

**Regulatory and Advertising Compliance**

* Build and run campaigns in accordance with ad platform policies governing financial products, including Google’s Personal Loans policy requirements for required disclosures, APR representation, and loan duration display, and the equivalent requirements for credit card and tax preparation advertising.
* Maintain geo-segmented campaigns and landing experiences reflecting state-level differences in rate caps, licensing, required disclosures, and product availability, so that consumers see only offers and terms available in their state.
* Apply fair lending principles to audience strategy, ensuring that targeting, exclusions, and audience filters do not introduce prohibited demographic discrimination under the Equal Credit Opportunity Act, Regulation B, and related requirements.
* Handle third-party credit propensity and bureau-sourced data in a privacy-compliant manner, including data clean rooms and DSP integrations, consistent with Fair Credit Reporting Act requirements.

**Measurement, Attribution, and Analytics**

* Own full-funnel attribution from ad click through funded loan, including offline conversions.
* Work with Marketing Technology team to ensure click identifiers and hashed first-party customer data are captured and identify and resolve breaks in the data pipeline.
* Partner with Analytics to validate that approval rates, loan sizes, and lifetime value map accurately to campaign performance.
* Design and run incrementality tests, including geo holdouts and lift studies, to validate that reported attribution reflects true incremental volume.
* Report against unit economics, Cost Per Funded Loan, Customer Lifetime Value, and first-payment default rate by acquisition channel, and monitor acquisition sources for lead quality and fraud signals.

**Direct Response Creative and Conversion Rate Optimization**

* Direct and write compliant direct-response ad copy and value propositions tailored to consumer loan use-cases.
* Own conversion rate optimization of landing pages, pre-qualification forms, and application steps to maximize completion rates without compromising lead quality or triggering fraud controls.

**The Opportunity**

  

Alpha Inc. isn’t looking for someone to simply **manage the marketing calendar.**

  

We’re looking for someone who can **build the strategy, rally the team, own the budget, strengthen relationships across Hawai?i—and prove what’s actually working.**

  

This is a hands-on leadership role for a marketer who understands that great marketing is bigger than social posts, sponsorships, events, and communications. It’s about connecting **strategy + relationships + data + dollars + execution** to meaningful business results.

  

You’ll own Alpha’s overall marketing strategy and brand direction, lead the Marketing team, build stronger systems and measurement practices, and help determine where Alpha should show up, where we should invest, and where we should change course.

  

One day you may be reviewing KPIs and marketing spend with leadership. The next, you’re building a community partnership on another island, coaching your team through a campaign, evaluating a sponsorship opportunity, or rolling up your sleeves to get a high-priority initiative across the finish line.

  

**If your idea of marketing leadership is equal parts strategist, relationship builder, operator, coach, and brand champion—we should talk.**

  

**About Alpha Inc.**

  

Founded and grown in Hawai?i, Alpha Inc. is a locally owned leader whose work spans construction, concrete, drilling, energy, infrastructure and vertical. Our story is told through the projects we build, the people behind them, the communities we serve, and the relationships we earn.

  

Marketing's job is to make that story matter—and make sure our investment in telling it has purpose.

  

We live by three core values:

  

**Leading with Heart** – Build relationships with humility and respect. Listen with intention, accept feedback with positive intent, and help people grow.

**Strength in Unity** – One team, many talents. Collaborate across departments, islands, projects, and communities because the best work happens together.

**Alpha Mentality** – Take ownership. Solve problems. Raise the bar. Keep improving. And when something isn't working, don't hide from it—fix it.

  

As Marketing Manager, you’ll be expected to bring those values to life in how you lead your team, represent Alpha, build partnerships, and deliver results.

  

**What You Will Own**

  

**Build the Marketing Strategy—Then Make It Happen**

* Develop and own Alpha’s annual marketing strategy and plan, translating company growth priorities, recruiting needs, business development objectives, culture, and community presence into focused initiatives.
* Create a clear roadmap so Marketing operates **proactively instead of reactively**—with defined priorities, campaigns, calendars, owners, deadlines, and outcomes.
* Know when to protect the plan and when a new opportunity is worth changing it.

  

**Own the Dollars—and the Results**

* Manage marketing initiatives within the approved budget and make thoughtful decisions about where Alpha’s marketing dollars can create the greatest impact.
* Establish meaningful **KPIs, dashboards, and reporting** across campaigns, digital channels, events, sponsorships, partnerships, content, and other marketing investments.
* We don't want reporting for reporting's sake. We want a leader who asks:
* **What worked? What didn't? Why? What did we learn? And where should we put the next dollar?**
* Use data, audience insights, feedback, and business priorities to continually improve Alpha’s marketing effectiveness.

  

**Build Relationships Across Hawai?i**

* Be a visible, credible, relationship-driven ambassador for Alpha across **Maui, O'ahu, Kaua'i, and Hawai'i Island.**
* Develop meaningful relationships with community organizations, clients, industry partners, vendors, and other stakeholders.
* You'll need to be comfortable walking into a room where you know everyone—and one where you know no one.
* Either way, you'll know how to build genuine relation

jobs.title: Marketing Analyst - Network Optimization
jobs.desc:
### **About Gen:**

Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries.

Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results.

When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs.

At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage.

If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen.

### **Role Overview**

The Marketing Analyst – Network Optimization will use data and experimentation to uncover what drives marketplace performance, turning analysis into clear, actionable recommendations that shape the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of tests. This role sits at the intersection of marketing analytics, data science, product, and commercial strategy.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, moving quickly from questions to analysis to action. At the core of the role: translating business questions into testable hypotheses, designing sound experiments, monitoring live tests, and delivering clear, data-driven readouts that inform optimization decisions — supported by day-to-day management of the test agenda.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Marketplace and Marketing Analytics**

* Conduct exploratory analysis to understand changes in customer behavior, traffic quality, offer engagement, and downstream outcomes.
* Monitor marketplace and funnel performance to identify optimization opportunities across customer experience, offer display, partner performance, and monetization.
* Support opportunity sizing and business-case development for proposed optimization initiatives.
* Partner with analytics and data science teams to improve measurement quality, data reliability, and experimentation velocity.
* Help develop repeatable processes for rapid testing, post-test analysis, and continuous optimization.

**Test Design and Execution**

* Support the development and maintenance of a prioritized test-and-learn agenda across network optimization, offer display, ranking, curation, pricing, eligibility, and related marketplace levers.
* Translate business opportunities and performance signals into clear hypotheses, test objectives, target populations, success metrics, and guardrail metrics.
* Help design A/B, holdout, multivariate, and other controlled experiments in partnership with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and business stakeholders.
* Coordinate test setup, launch readiness, audience splits, documentation, timelines, and stakeholder communication.
* Track execution from initial idea through implementation, launch, monitoring, analysis, and final recommendation.
* Work quickly and pragmatically while maintaining analytical rigor and attention to detail.

**Test Readouts and Reporting**

* Monitor live experiments and summarize performance across key funnel and marketplace metrics.
* Produce concise, decision-oriented test readouts covering methodology, results, limitations, learnings, and recommended next steps.

**Position Summary**
====================

BMG360’s Performance Media department is hiring a Client Services Manager to lead campaign strategy and client management for an assigned book of accounts, supported by a team of Senior Analysts and Analysts.

This is a commercial role, not a coordination role. Performance Media buys media at risk and is paid on delivered performance, which means every account carries both a volume commitment to the client and a margin commitment to BMG360. The Client Services Manager owns both on their book: hitting the client’s call and lead thresholds while protecting the profitability of the buys that produce them.

Reporting to the Director, Performance Media, this role is the early warning system for the group. The Director owns the department P&L and approves media risk while the Manager is the person closest to the accounts, responsible for seeing a problem or an opportunity first and bringing it forward with a recommendation attached.

**Scope**
=========

**Title**

Client Services Manager, Performance Media

  

**Reports to**

Director, Performance Media

  

**Direct reports**

Senior Analyst and Analyst

  

**Accountable for**

Revenue, volume delivery, and gross margin on an assigned book of Performance Media accounts

  

**Partners with**

Media, Creative, Ad Operations, Call Routing, Business Development, Finance

* Serve as the senior day-to-day point of contact, with the strategic credibility to lead a client conversation about performance rather than relay it.

------------------------------------

* Own gross margin on the assigned book, not revenue alone. Understand how each campaign makes money and where it stops making money.

jobs.title: Social Media & Marketing Coordinator
jobs.desc:
We are looking for an experienced, creative, and metrics-driven **Social Media & Marketing Coordinator** to take ownership of our social media presence and grow our brand, community, and customer engagement, both in-store and online.

This role will focus heavily on short-form content, social media management, community engagement, event / product promotion, and measurable audience growth across platforms including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and others.

This is not simply a “post a few times a week” position. We are looking for someone who understands marketing as a measurable business function and can explain what is working, what is not, and how strategy should change based on performance. Additionally, familiarity with trading card games, the hobby space in general & interpersonal communications is essential.

Lastly, this role will balance their Marketing responsibilities with normal, front of house duties. This includes, and is not limited to, greeting and handling customer requests, running our POS, handling trades, using our pricing / restocking systems and housekeeping. This will be roughly 1/3rd of your time spent on-site at the time of hiring - this can be subject to change if scope of the role changes.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage company social media accounts across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
* Create original short-form video, photo, and promotional content.
* Promote tournaments, Organized Play, product releases, prereleases, sales, and store events.
* Handle in-house tasks such as running the POS, stocking and restocking, handling trades
* Photograph and film products, events, employees, customers, and in-store activity as appropriate.
* Build and maintain a consistent brand voice across platforms.
* Engage with comments, messages, mentions, and online communities.
* Develop strategies to improve reach, followers, engagement, video performance, event awareness, and customer interaction.
* Maintain a forward-looking content calendar around releases, events, promotions, and store priorities.
* Track KPIs and platform analytics.
* Identify trends, growth opportunities, successful content, and underperforming content.
* Provide weekly reporting on performance, opportunities, and progress toward established marketing OKRs.
* Recommend changes to content and strategy based on measurable results.

**Performance & Reporting**

This position reports directly to the **Store Manager**.

The Coordinator will maintain marketing OKRs and provide regular performance reporting to store leadership, including metrics such as:

* Audience and follower growth
* Reach and impressions
* Engagement
* Video views and watch time
* Content and campaign performance
* Event promotion results
* Emerging opportunities
* Progress toward established objectives

Success will be measured not only by how much content is created, but by the ability to understand **why content performed the way it did and what should be done next.**

**Qualifications**

Applicants should have:

* At least **2 years of professional experience** in marketing, social media, digital marketing, content creation, community management, or a comparable role.
* Experience managing social media accounts in a professional or commercial environment.
* Experience creating short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, YouTube Shorts, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with KPIs, OKRs, audience growth, engagement metrics, customer experience, and metric-driven decision making.
* Strong written communication and organizational skills.
* The ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* The ability to interpret marketing data and clearly explain what it means for the business.
* Must be able to work full shifts on Thursday, Saturday & Sundays.

**Corporate marketing experience is preferred but not required.**

A college or university degree is **not required**. Relevant pro

**Overview**  
Fundelivered is hiring an experienced Social Media Content Creator & Manager! We’re a fast-growing mystery box company with over 1.8 million followers across our social channels, and we’re looking for the best of the best: a creative, trend-savvy person with fresh ideas and a real eye for content that stops the scroll. You’ll lead our social strategy, create standout content, manage relationships with the wide range of influencers we partner with and help grow our community across every platform. You don’t need to live in Ocala, but you must be willing to come to our warehouse at least one day a week or every other week for filming and creative content. Pay is $50,000–$62,000 per year, depending on experience. You can email your resume, along with links to your portfolio or accounts you’ve grown, directly to: jenabutler@fundelivered.com

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute a social media strategy that grows our audience, engagement and sales.
* Film engaging content on-site at our Ocala warehouse at least one day a week, including unboxings, behind-the-scenes, team moments and trending formats.
* Edit short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and Facebook.
* Write captions and posts that match our fun, playful brand voice.
* Stay ahead of social media trends, sounds and formats, and quickly turn them into on-brand content.
* Bring fresh, original ideas to the table regularly. We want someone who sets trends, not just follows them.
* Help manage relationships with the wide range of influencers and creators we work with, from first outreach to sending boxes, tracking content and building long-term partnerships.
* Plan and maintain a content calendar to keep posting consistent across all channels.
* Track analytics and report on what’s working, then use those insights to improve content and grow our reach.
* Keep an eye on competitors, audience feedback and what people are saying about us online.
* Engage with our community through comments and DMs.
* Work closely with leadership to bring new content ideas and campaigns to life.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience growing social media channels for a brand or business is required. Please include links to accounts you’ve grown!
* A strong creative eye for filming, editing and storytelling that makes content stand out.
* Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram and YouTube trends, algorithms and best practices.
* Experience filming and editing short-form video, using apps like CapCut or similar.

**Our philosophy** is harmonious health for pets, people, and planet. Our tagline says it simply:

jobs.desc:
**Job Overview**

T7X is hiring a GoHighLevel (GHL) expert to own our CRM, marketing automation, and investor communications infrastructure end to end. You will build and run the systems that move a contact from first touch to booked call to engaged investor, and you will turn that activity into clear reporting leadership can act on. This role sits at the intersection of marketing operations, investor relations, and data. You will work inside the T7X GHL agency account and its subaccounts, alongside our marketing team, business development, compliance, and an outside GHL configuration partner

**GHL Build and Administration**

* Own day-to-day administration of the GHL agency account and subaccounts: pipelines, custom fields, tags, users, permissions, and snapshots.
* Build and maintain workflows, triggers, and multi-step nurture sequences across email and SMS.
* Create reusable templates and snapshots so new campaigns and projects launch in days, not weeks.
* Keep the account clean: deduplicate contacts, standardize naming conventions, and document every build.

**Investor Relations and CRM Management**

* Structure the CRM around the investor lifecycle: prospect, qualified, engaged, committed, and existing investor.
* Build segmented communication tracks for prospects, current investors, partners, and community members.
* Support investor events, calls, and roadshows with registration flows, reminders, and follow-up.
* Manage contact ownership and handoffs between marketing, business development, and leadership.
* Route investor-facing content through compliance review before it is sent, and maintain approved templates.

**Reporting and Analytics**

* Build dashboards covering lead volume, source attribution, conversion by pipeline
* stage, email and SMS performance, event attendance, and partner performance.
* Pull data from GHL, Zoom, ad platforms, and web analytics into a single reporting view.
* Deliver a weekly performance report with clear takeaways and recommended actions.
* Audit data quality and fix the root cause, not just the symptom.

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience, including agency-level account and subaccount management.
* Proven track record building complex GHL workflows, pipelines, and multi-channel sequences from scratch.
* Direct experience integrating GHL with Zoom, SMS providers, forms, and calendars.
* Working knowledge ofA2P 10DLC registration, TCPA rules, and CAN-SPAM requirements.
* Strong marketing fundamentals: funnels, segmentation, lead scoring, nurture strategy, and attribution.
* Experience managing CRM relationships at scale, with investor, client, or high-value contact pipelines.
* Comfort with data analytics: building dashboards, connecting data sources, and translating numbers into decisions.
* Advanced spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets or Excel), including pivots, lookups, and data cleanup.
* Clear written communication and the discipline to document systems so others can run them.

**What Success Looks Like in 90 Days**

**1. Days 1 to 30**: Full audit of the GHL account, integrations, and data quality, with a prioritized fix list. Every active workflow documented.

**2. Days 31 to 60**: Zoom, SMS, and form integrations running cleanly with automated reminders and attended vs. no-show follow-up. Investor pipeline stages standardized.

**3. Days 61 to 90**: Live dashboard covering lead source, pipeline conversion, event attendance, and messaging performance. Weekly reporting cadence in place and reusable sequence templates ready for new campaigns.

**To apply, send your resume plus two or three examples of GHL builds you have created (screenshots, Loom walkthroughs, or a short written breakdown). Include one dashboard or report you built and the decision it drove.**

**Shortlisted candidates will complete a short practical exercise: map a Zoom webinar registration and follow-up workflow in GHL, including SMS reminders and attended vs. no show branches.**

opportunity across 23 counties in the Greater Atlanta region.

**WHERE MARKETING MEETS IMPACT**  
The Manager, Marketing Operations & Events helps the Community Foundation for Greater Atlanta’s
  
Marketing & Communications (MarCom) team operate efficiently, stay organized, and deliver highquality work on time.  
This role manages project intake, workflow, timelines, production coordination, and event execution
  
across the department. The Manager works closely with MarCom colleagues and teams across

and reduce last-minute work and production bottlenecks.

bring that strategy to life through strong planning, logistics, production, and coordination.

priorities.

partners.

project setup, workflows, statuses, templates, permissions, naming conventions, and
  
reporting. Also partner with IT and other departments, as appropriate, to implement needed
  
systems.  

* Help establish clear processes, templates, and ways of working that improve efficiency and

accountability across the department.  

* Maintain organized repositories of final creative, templates, brand assets, photography, video

and other MarCom materials so approved files are easy to find, use, and share.  
  
**Campaign & Production Coordination**  

* Coordinate production across campaigns involving content, creative, digital, email, web,

social, print, and paid media.  

* Manage project timelines, handoffs, and approvals from initial request through final delivery.
* Help ensure teams have the information, assets, and approvals needed to keep work moving.
* Coordinate with internal colleagues, agencies, and vendors to support campaign launches

and major communications initiatives.  

* Maintain project documentation, schedules, and status updates.

  
**Event Planning & Execution**  

* Support planning and execution for CFGA-hosted and sponsored events.
* Develop event timelines, project plans, production schedules, and run-of-show documents.
* Manage event logistics including venues, catering, audiovisual needs, signage, registration,

rentals, and other production requirements.  

* Coordinate with speakers, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure event details are

complete and on schedule.  

* Manage on-site execution and serve as an operational point person during events.
* Coordinate post-event logistics, vendor follow-up, and debriefs.

Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.

Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.

Powered by technology and a network of 1500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

Fooda is hiring a Content Marketing Manager to lead our content program and, over time, the team that produces it.

You don’t need to be an expert in every area of digital marketing, but you should be comfortable learning new tools, accepting feedback, managing multiple projects, and figuring out how to turn a client’s goals into great content.

**Here’s What You Can Expect**

**Creative content creation.** A major part of your job will be creating content for our clients. You’ll write social media posts, take photos, film and edit short-form videos, create graphics, and help develop content ideas that fit each client’s brand.

**Photography and videography.** You’ll regularly visit local businesses to capture photos and video. This could include interviews, promotional videos, social media reels, events, products, employees, facilities, and other content that helps tell a client’s story.

**Social media management.** You’ll help manage social media accounts for local businesses, including developing content calendars, writing copy, creating graphics, editing photos and videos, scheduling posts, and monitoring content after it is published.

**Graphic design.** You’ll create professional graphics and marketing materials for social media, email campaigns, digital advertising, promotions, events, and other client needs.

**Copywriting.** Good marketing starts with good communication. You’ll write social media captions, promotional copy, email campaigns, website and campaign content, video scripts, and other marketing materials.

**Email and SMS marketing.** You’ll help create newsletters, promotional emails, automated campaigns, customer communications, and occasional SMS campaigns. This includes writing copy, creating graphics, organizing audiences, testing campaigns, and reviewing results.

**Client interaction.** You won’t be responsible for selling, but you will interact directly with clients. You’ll participate in meetings, gather information and creative assets, coordinate shoots, request approvals, discuss projects, and help clients understand what we need from them to keep their marketing moving.

**Project management.** You’ll often have multiple clients and projects moving at the same time. Keeping track of deadlines, approvals, shoots, content calendars, revisions, and deliverables is an important part of the job.

**Trying new things.** Digital marketing changes constantly, and so do we. Expect to regularly try new technology, software, social platforms, AI tools, equipment, and processes that help us produce better work and work more efficiently.

**Local travel.** While much of your work can be completed remotely, great content doesn’t always happen behind a computer. You’ll regularly travel to client locations and events to capture photography and video or meet with clients. Reliable transportation is required.

**What We’re Looking For**

You’re a creative person who likes actually **making things**. You get satisfaction from turning an idea into a finished video, photograph, graphic, social media post, or marketing campaign.

jobs.desc:
**About Doss**
==============

**DOSS is building an Operations Cloud for the real world.**
------------------------------------------------------------

A modern, AI-native platform for physical product businesses to manage the flow of goods, dollars, and data in real time, across:

* Procurement
* Inventory
* Orders
* Fulfillment
* Finance

**Built to replace spreadsheet chaos and rigid, consultant-heavy ERPs.** Fast time-to-value, adaptable as the business evolves.

Through our Adaptive Resource Platform (ARP) and unified operational data model, teams deploy quickly, automate workflows, and make changes without months of re-implementation.

**We recently raised a $55M Series B**, co-led by Madrona and Premji Invest. Participation from Intuit Ventures, Theory Ventures, General Catalyst, Contrary Capital, and Pathlight VC.

DOSS is trusted by fast-growing operators to run critical operations with speed, control, and confidence.

**About This Role**
-------------------

The Growth Manager will own paid acquisition end-to-end at Doss—from strategy to hands-on-keyboard execution. This is a hands-on role across our paid channels, primarily **Google, LinkedIn, and Meta**, that range from 0 1 builds to scaling programs that are already live. You'll be responsible for standing up new channels, scaling proven ones, and designing the experiments that unlock new pipeline volume for our GTM team.

You'll work directly with the **Director of Growth** and own this area end-to-end, collaborating closely with product marketing, sales, and design to turn paid spend into qualified pipeline. This is a rare opportunity to join early and scale a function that’ll drive significant revenue for DOSS.

You'll also be part of a broader testing engine at Doss—one built to move from market insight to live test to result as fast as possible. Your job is to keep that loop tight: design the test, ship it, read the result, and feed the learning back into the next round.

Above all else, this role is about creating leverage—through disciplined experimentation, scalable campaigns, and rigorous measurement that leads to better decisions about where every dollar goes.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **#1: Achieve the pipeline goals.** Execute your plan to drive our incredible growth through new opportunities from digital channels.
* **Own paid advertising end-to-end.** Set strategy and execute it yourself across Google, LinkedIn, and Meta—campaign structure, audience targeting, bidding, budget pacing, creative briefs, ad copy, and landing pages.
* **Build 0 1 and scale what works.** Launch new paid channels from scratch and scale live channels efficiently, protecting CAC and efficiency as spend grows.
* **Run rigorous experiments.** Design and run rigorous A/B tests with a clear scientific method—form hypotheses, isolate variables, reach statistical significance, and turn results into repeatable plays. Test constantly across offers, messaging, creative, audiences, and formats.
* **Measure leading and lagging indicators.** Define the metrics that matter at each funnel stage, instrument tracking to measure them accurately, and use leading indicators to act before lagging outcomes confirm them.
* **Collaborate cross-functionally.** Partner with product marketing on positioning and messaging, with sales on lead quality and pipeline feedback loops, and with design on high-performing creative.
* **Report on performance.** Maintain clear dashboards and a tight feedback loop with the Director of Growth & VP of Marketing on spend, efficiency, and pipeline contribution.

**About You**
-------------

* **5+ years running paid ads across multiple channels.** You have a deep, current understanding of Google, LinkedIn, and Meta ad platforms and have managed real budgets across them.
* **Managed budgets in the $1M+ range.** You've owned and deployed seven-figure annual ad spend, and you know how to scale spend without losing efficiency.
* **Hands-on ope

Onnit is an Austin, Texas based health and wellness company that sells dietary supplements direct to consumers and through retail distribution. Unlike other supplement brands, Onnit enables strength from within, empowering individuals to operate at their peak every day. Backed by medical professionals, industry experts, and a loyal community, we are staying true to our mission of total human optimization.

Our mission, with our science-backed and disruptive portfolio, is to improve the health and well-being of millions of consumers and continue leading in the Health and Wellness space.

If you are interested in joining a culture that strives for Curiosity, Discipline, Approachability, Commitment, and Ownership Mindset then we invite you to join our mission to optimize human potential!

**JOB SUMMARY**

We're looking for an analytical, hands-on lifecycle marketer to own email, SMS, and customer retention, with a particular focus on subscription growth and churn reduction. You'll execute the strategy and work in Klaviyo, from creating content blocks and building campaigns to launching flows, refining segments, and analyzing results. This role is designed for someone with roughly 5 years of relevant experience who wants meaningful ownership while staying close to the work.

Email and SMS strategy and execution

* Own the email and SMS calendar, balancing promotional campaigns with customer education, replenishment, subscription conversion, and retention messaging.
* Personally build, QA, schedule, and launch campaigns and automated flows in Klaviyo.
* Create, maintain, and manage reusable content blocks and templates; assemble and format messages for launch.
* Build and refine customer segments using purchase behavior, subscription status, engagement, lifecycle stage, and cohort insights.
* Develop and optimize journeys such as welcome, post-purchase, replenishment, subscription onboarding, cancellation prevention, and winback.
* Run practical tests across messaging, offers, creative, timing, frequency, and audience selection, then apply what you learn.
* Maintain strong execution standards across mobile rendering, links, personalization, deliverability, and consent practices.

Subscription Growth and Churn Reduction

* Execute lifecycle marketing initiatives that convert one-time purchasers into subscribers and help existing subscribers stay engaged.
* Identify which customers are most likely to benefit from subscription and develop relevant messages, offers, and conversion journeys.
* Analyze subscription churn, cancellation patterns, and customer behavior to identify opportunities to improve retention.
* Build and test onboarding, education, replenishment, save, and reactivation initiatives that address those opportunities.
* Bring customer insights to product, brand, and customer-experience partners to help strengthen the overall subscriber experience.

Lifecycle Strategy and Practical Analytics

* Develop lifecycle and cohort strategies that reflect how different customers discover, buy, return, subscribe, and lapse.
* Analyze cohort retention, repeat purchase, customer lifetime

jobs.desc:
**Who We Are & Who We Serve**

Visit Corvallis is the destination marketing organization serving Corvallis and Benton County, Oregon. Our mission is to enhance Corvallis and Benton County’s prosperity by elevating its visitor economy. We do this by connecting people to experiences that show what’s great about Corvallis. When we do that well, visitors discover experiences that delight, restore, and surprise them; local businesses benefit; and tourism strengthens our community.

We’re a small and nimble team, where people and ideas matter. We all wear many different hats, and good work has a visible impact. This role offers meaningful ownership and direction in our marketing programming today, with room to grow into senior marketing strategic leadership.

**What We’re Trying To Do**

At its best, destination marketing is matchmaking. Not everyone is going to love Corvallis, and that’s okay. Our job is to find the people who will.

When we do that well, visitors discover experiences that delight, restore, and surprise them; local businesses benefit; and tourism strengthens our community.

Our goal is to make Visit Corvallis one of Oregon’s most engaging, distinctive, and inviting destination brands, and the Marketing Manager’s goal is to build a smarter marketing operation underneath it.

**What You’ll Lead**

This position will oversee Visit Corvallis’ marketing ecosystem, working with our team and contracted agencies to lead:

* Brand strategy and creative development
* Paid media and digital advertising
* Website strategy, AI, SEO/SEM, and conversion
* Google Analytics, campaign measurement, and KPI reporting
* Public relations and earned media
* Social media and content strategy
* Email marketing and consumer e-newsletters
* Photography, video, and creative asset development
* Influencer and visiting media programs
* Visitor guide and other visitor-facing content

You won’t need to personally execute every piece, but you will need to understand how the pieces work together, ask good questions, manage our partners, and turn strategy into action.

You’ll also help develop our annual marketing plan, manage the content calendar, identify creative needs, monitor performance, and build a stronger culture of experimentation and A/B testing.

Most importantly, we want data to change what we do. We aren’t interested in producing reports simply to produce them. We want someone who looks at the results and asks, **“What should we try next?”**

**You’ll Probably Love This Job If:**

* You’re curious and naturally ask why and how.
* You’re both creative and strategic. You can find an interesting insight in the data and then ask, **“What’s the story here?”**
* You have strong creative instincts, excellent visual taste, aren’t afraid to take risks, and have solid communications skills.
* You like testing your own ideas. Being proven wrong doesn’t bother you nearly as much as never finding out whether you were right.
* You’re organized and understand that structure creates freedom, but you don’t need every answer before moving forward.
* You’re willing to be bold, take thoughtful risks and challenge the expected.
* When something isn’t working, you look for the next solution rather than explaining why nothing can be done.

**What You Need To Bring**

* We’re less interested in someone who checks every traditional box than in the right combination of experience, judgment and potential.
* Experience marketing a consumer product, brand, commodity, place, food or beverage product, outdoor brand, or other competitive consumer offering would be especially interesting to us.

Visit Corvallis is looking for a strategic, creative marketing leader who gets excited about building things, asking why, testing ideas and finding better ways to connect people with a place they’ll genuinely enjoy.

Every Noonday piece comes with a story: a place, a material, a technique, and the artisan who made it. jobs.desc:
About Signature :

**Signature HealthCARE** is a family-based healthcare company offering integrated services across multiple states. Our continuum of care includes skilled nursing, rehabilitation, assisted and memory care, and home-based services supported by innovative technologies like telehealth and Care.ai-enabled solutions.

We are committed to advancing person-directed care and quality outcomes. Many of our facilities continue to receive high performance ratings and accreditations. As an award-winning organization recognized over the years by national outlets such as *U.S. News & World Report*, we take pride in fostering compassionate care environments and being an employer of choice in the healthcare industry.

Overview:

* The Digital Marketing Manager owns Signature HealthCARE’s corporate and facility social media presence and serves as technical owner of the Sprinklr platform. Equal parts strategist, builder, and operator, this role sets and executes corporate content strategy, runs a multi-facility Facebook and LinkedIn program, administers and troubleshoots the platforms that program runs on, and produces supporting graphics.
* The role partners closely with the Director of Public Relations & Brand Storytelling to turn sourced stories into social, video, and visual content, supervises the Social Media Coordinator, and is accountable for the quality, compliance, and consistency of everything the social program publishes. Facilities are this role’s internal customers — responsive, reliable service matters as much as creative skill.

How you Will make a Difference:

* **Corporate Social Media**
  + Own strategy, editorial calendar, content creation, and publishing across Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, X, and YouTube (Facebook and LinkedIn are priority channels)
  + Drive measurable audience and engagement growth
  + Lead recurring corporate campaigns
* **Facebook & Meta Platform Management**
  + Administer Meta Business Suite and Business Manager — roles, permissions, asset organization, verification, and troubleshooting

* **Creative Production & Design**
  + Produce day-to-day graphics in Canva

**About JM Test Systems**

JM Test Systems is a multi-division test, measurement, calibration, repair, and electrical safety company serving industrial, utility, and energy customers across the U.S. and Canada. Through equipment sales, rentals, calibration, onsite testing, and electrical safety lab services, we support the contractors, utilities, EPC firms, and OEMs that keep critical infrastructure running.

**The Opportunity**

Our customers rely on us for the equipment and services that keep their operations safe and running. We’re looking for a Marketing Growth Specialist to help more of them find us, and to give them reasons to keep coming back.

You’ll own the work that turns online interest into revenue: paid search, SEO, marketing analytics, and website and eCommerce conversion. You’ll dig into the data, find where the customer journey breaks down, test fixes, and scale what works. You’ll work from our Baton Rouge headquarters with the Marketing Manager, sales teams, and branch leaders. Together you’ll set performance goals and build the reporting leadership uses to make decisions.

This role suits someone who enjoys both the numbers and the creative side of marketing, and who’s curious enough to learn technical products and the industries that depend on them. In your first year, success means:

* Steadily improving lead-to-opportunity conversion
* Building repeatable playbooks for core campaigns, such as calibration renewals and rental promotions
* Delivering reporting that marketing and sales leaders trust and use

**Key Responsibilities & Outcomes**

* **Drive qualified demand.** Manage Google Ads and paid social budgets. Test targeting, bidding, and creative to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and return on spend.

* **Show marketing’s revenue impact.** Strengthen attribution so we know which channels drive pipeline and where to invest next.
* **Run a disciplined experimentation program.** Prioritize growth tests, define success measures, and turn what works into documented campaign playbooks.
* **Align with sales and branches.** Work with sales teams across our branch network and with content and design partners to launch campaigns and assets (landing pages, emails, ad copy, sales enablement) that match regional and industry priorities. Use competitor and market insight to shape them.

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 3+ years in digital or growth marketing with proven results in paid acquisition, analytics, or conversion optimization, including hands-on Google Ads and budget management
* Working knowledge of GA4, Google Search Console, SEO fundamentals, and A/B testing, plus strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for reporting and dashboards
* Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo, or a similar CRM or marketing automation platform
* Strong analytical and writing skills: you can turn data into clear recommendations and write copy that converts, while managing several campaigns and stakeholders at once

**Preferred**

* Experience in B2B, industrial, or technical services marketing, especially test and measurement, electrical products, or the Oil & Gas,

jobs.title: Email Marketing Specialist
jobs.desc:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers connect and simplify their operations, keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.

Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to empower product sellers to thrive by making selling as easy as buying. We are committed to this mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world.

Serving over 8,000 customers globally, processing more than 125 million orders per year, and supporting over $35B of Gross Merchandise Value, Cin7 has been rated best overall in inventory management software in 2024 by Forbes Advisor.

### **How you'll make an impact:**

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to own email creation in HubSpot. Reporting to the Marketing Operations Manager, you'll build, test, and schedule the emails that reach our prospects, customers, and partners, including newsletters, event invitations, product announcements, and nurture campaigns.

  

This role is hands-on. You'll take campaign briefs and copy from across the marketing team and turn them into polished, accurate, on-brand emails. You'll build the lists and segments behind each send, use test results and performance data to improve future emails, and keep the email calendar and approval process running smoothly. You'll also create simple graphics in Canva when our graphic designer is busy with larger projects.

  

You'll work with a small, collaborative team and with people in several time zones. Your work will be seen by our prospects, customers, and partners every week.

You will build emails across a variety of campaign types:

* **Workflow-based drip campaigns** (6+ weeks)
* **Automated nurtures** (demo, free trial, lifecycle stages)
* **One-off campaigns** (trade shows, announcements, etc.)
* **Webinar promotion series** (invites, reminders, follow-ups)
* **Monthly newsletter** (gather content from stakeholders, build, iterate, and send)

### **What you'll do:**

* **Own email creation in HubSpot**, building marketing emails from start to finish using templates, modules, and personalization tokens.
* **Build and segment lists**, creating targeted lists in HubSpot so each email reaches the right audience.
* **Run A/B tests**, testing subject lines, content, send times, and calls to action, and applying what you learn to future emails.
* **Analyze email metrics to guide decisions**, tracking open rates, click rates, and unsubscribes, and using the results to recommend changes to content, timing, and audiences.
* **Maintain the email calendar**, planning and scheduling sends across teams so campaigns are coordinated and audiences aren't over-emailed.
* **Manage the approval process for email sending**, getting emails to reviewers on time, tracking feedback and sign-off, and making sure nothing is sent before it's approved.
* **Maintain oversight of marketing team inbox**, organizing, deleting and responding to email responses as necessary.
* **Test every email before it goes out**, checking links, merge fields, recipient lists, and how each email looks on desktop and mobile.
* **Turn campaign briefs into finished emails**, working with marketing team members to get copy, images, and calls to action ready for review.
* **Create basic graphics in Canva**, including email banners, buttons, and simple images, using Cin7 brand guidelines and approved templates. Hand larger design projects to our graphic designer.
* **Keep email assets organized**, including templates, saved content, and image files, so the team can find and reuse them.
* **Follow email best practices and privacy rules**, including unsubscribe handling and consent requirements for the regions we send to.

### **What you'll bring:**

**What you'll bring:**

* 2-3 years of experience in email marketing, marketing operations, or a similar role.
* Hands-on experience

You own the affiliate creator program for Fast Lane Athletics on TikTok Shop: which creators get products, what they post, and whether it makes money. Full-time, remote, US based. You report to the TikTok Shop lead and work directly with the owner.

**ABOUT RTR**

RTR Vehicles is an OEM+ Ford performance brand founded by Vaughn Gittin Jr. We build and sell Mustang RTR and Bronco RTR vehicles, plus aftermarket parts and merch, through Ford dealers, direct to consumer, and international partners. Our customers are enthusiasts. They can smell fake from a mile away, so the marketing has to be real.

**THE JOB IN SHORT**

You keep marketing moving. Requests come in, launches need assets, emails need building, product pages need updating, and somebody has to make sure it all gets done and gets done right. That's you. You're the person who builds, publishes and follows up, so the Marketing Manager can focus on strategy and decisions.

It's a fast, hands-on seat. You'll touch email, web, photography, dealer materials and events in the same week, and you'll learn how a performance vehicle brand actually gets to market.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

· **Run the request queue.** Log incoming marketing requests in Monday.com, track status and deadlines, and follow up with teammates and outside partners until things are delivered.

· **Build emails and flows.** Build campaigns in Klaviyo from approved copy, set up sign-up forms and flows for events and promos, QA before send, and troubleshoot automations that break.

· **Support dealer marketing.** Put together dealer-facing materials, spotlights, communications and asset packs, and help create vehicle addendums.

· **Help with events.** Capture photos and content at RTR events and support marketing coordination for activations.

· **Pull the numbers.** Pull weekly performance from Google Analytics, Klaviyo, Shopify and Triple Whale, track merch sell-through, and keep our dashboards current.

· **Watch customer feedback.** Approve product reviews and make sure customer service is answering product Q&A.

· **Back up the team.** Pitch in on social, PR and agency coordination when needed.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

· Okay with a fast pace, shifting priorities and occasional weekend event work

· 80 hours of PTO in year one, plus company holidays

Send your resume and a link to or a few samples of your work (photos, emails, product pages, anything you built). Samples beat cover letters.
